channel.title: Microsoft 365 Message Center and Roadmap Archive
channel.description: Latest Microsoft 365 Message Center messages and Microsoft 365 Roadmap posts. Message Center posts vary by tenant; always use your tenant's Message Center as the source of truth.

item.title: MC1458470: Simplified Copilot experience in Microsoft Outlook
item.description: Microsoft Outlook's Copilot experience will be refreshed by September 2026 with a simplified, chat-centered design in both full-page and side pane views. Enhancements include improved navigation, chat layout, agent interaction, and Work IQ controls. No user or admin action is needed; administrators should update related documentation and inform users.

item.title: MC1458472: Simplified Copilot experience in Microsoft Teams
item.description: Microsoft Teams' Copilot experience is updated with a simplified, chat-centered design available in full-page and side pane views starting September 2026. Enhancements include easier navigation, improved chat layout, Work IQ controls, and a new Tasks view in full-screen mode. No user or admin action is needed.

item.title: MC1469957: [Whiteboard] Legacy Whiteboard migration to OneDrive
item.description: Updated September 15, 2026: This message does not apply to Government customers. We apologize for the confusion, and you can safely disregard this message. Microsoft Whiteboard is migrating from legacy Azure-based storage to OneDrive-backed storage. Migration must be completed by September 25, 2026; afterward, legacy Whiteboards become read-only and are deleted by October 16, 2026. Admins should inventory, notify users, and ensure migration before these deadlines.

item.title: MC1472443: 60-Day Reminder: Windows 11, version 23H2 Enterprise and Education editions reach end of updates on November 10, 2026
item.description: On November 10, 2026, Windows 11, version 23H2 Enterprise and Education editions will reach end of updates. The November 2026 Windows security update will be the last update available for these editions. After this date, devices running these editions will no longer receive monthly security and non-security preview updates containing protections from the latest security threats. To continue receiving monthly security and quality updates, we recommend updating eligible devices running Windows 11,...

item.title: MC1472438: Dynamics 365 Project Operations – View budget details from the project's left navigation (Preview)
item.description: We are announcing the ability to access budget details directly from the left navigation pane with the new Project Budget management experience in Dynamics 365 Project Operations. This feature will reach public preview on September 30, 2026. How does this affect me? This feature enhances the Project Budget management experience by providing:Improved budget visibility: View budget information in a dedicated experience that makes key budget details easier to access and review.Clearer budget versio...

item.title: MC1446799: Microsoft Teams: Multilingual meeting recaps support personalized recap translation
item.description: Microsoft Teams meeting recaps will now personalize recap translations based on each participant's selected language during the meeting. Users can view recaps initially in their chosen language and switch to other supported languages. The rollout begins August 2026 with no admin action required.

item.title: MC1472430: Dynamics 365 Project Operations - Support subscription billing for Project Operations
item.description: We are announcing support for subscription billing for Project Operations in Dynamics 365 Project Operations. This feature will reach public preview on September 30, 2026. How does this affect me? This feature automates recurring invoicing to reduce manual intervention. It improves financial control, supports flexibility, and positions businesses to scale subscription offerings and forecast monthly recurring revenue (MRR) more accurately. Core capabilities of this feature include: Recurring bill...

item.title: MC1443517: Microsoft Teams: External presenters can manage event production controls
item.description: Microsoft Teams will allow event organizers to grant production control to trusted external presenters, including federated (B2B) and guest users, enabling them to manage event production. This feature rolls out from early August to early October 2026, requiring no admin action but recommends updating policies and training.

item.title: MC1472429: Support for Office LTSC 2021, and additional apps will end on October 13, 2026
item.description: Support for Office LTSC 2021 and related apps ends October 13, 2026, with no further updates or support. Users should upgrade to Microsoft 365 Apps or Office LTSC 2024 to maintain security, compliance, and performance before that date.

item.title: MC1461153: Microsoft Teams: Add multiple steps when building a workflow from scratch
item.description: Microsoft Teams Workflows will soon support multiple actions in a single workflow, enabling richer automations that reduce manual tasks, consolidate processes, and improve productivity. The rollout starts early September 2026, requiring no admin action, and offers a simpler, step-based workflow design for users.

item.title: MC1472428: Dynamics 365 Project Operations- Improve contract management usability
item.description: We are announcing improvements to contract management usability in Dynamics 365 Project Operations. This feature will reach public preview on September 30, 2026. How does this affect me? This update transforms the contract into a central, intuitive workspace where all contract-related information is easier to access, understand, and act upon. The redesigned layout provides a clearer overview of contract status, financials, and performance, helping users work faster and with greater confidence. C...

item.title: MC1462471: Microsoft SharePoint : Dashboard Card Visibility on Mobile
item.description: Microsoft SharePoint now allows dashboard authors to control individual card visibility on mobile devices, enhancing mobile user experience. The rollout begins mid-September 2026 and completes by month-end. No action is required, but authors are encouraged to optimize dashboards for mobile users. Existing settings remain unchanged.

item.title: MC1314949: Microsoft Viva Copilot Analytics: Daily Copilot usage snapshot with fresh data
item.description: Microsoft Viva Insights now offers a daily updated Power BI report, "Microsoft 365 Copilot latest usage snapshot," showing up to three months of Copilot usage for analysts with the Insights Analyst role. It requires at least 50 Copilot licenses, supports advanced filtering, and rolled out globally by early September 2026.

item.title: MC1472252: Dynamics 365 Project Operations - Enable on-account category in Dataverse
item.description: We are announcing the ability to sync transaction categories for retainers and milestones between Microsoft Dataverse and Dynamics 365 in Dynamics 365 Project Operations. This feature will reach public preview on September 30, 2026. How does this affect me? This feature enables categorization of retainers, milestones, and advances for accurate revenue posting in Dynamics 365 Finance. This feature will introduce the following capabilities:Expose Transaction Category field: This adds a Transaction...

item.title: MC1472247: Dynamics 365 Project Operations - Enable multiple baselines for a project
item.description: We are announcing the ability to enable multiple baselines for a project in Dynamics 365 Project Operations. This feature will reach public preview on September 30, 2026. How does this affect me? Multiple baselines provide a clear historical view of how a user's project plan evolves over time without losing earlier snapshots. This allows users to track changes in scope, schedule, cost, and effort across different stages of the project and understand the impact of each adjustment. When this featu...

item.title: MC1472214: Dynamics 365 Project Operations - Enable Change Order Management
item.description: We are announcing the ability to enable structured creation, review, and approval of contract updates in Dynamics 365 Project Operations. This feature will reach public preview on September 30, 2026. How does this affect me? This feature introduces a structured, auditable process for creating, evaluating, and approving change orders on active project contracts. It allows users to capture updates to scope, pricing, resources, or timelines and apply those approved changes directly to the contract...

item.title: MC1472205: Dynamics 365 Project Operations - Define the accounting date at invoice level
item.description: We are announcing the ability to define the accounting date at the invoice level in Dynamics 365 Project Operations. This feature will reach public preview on September 30, 2026. How does this affect me? With this feature, users can set the accounting date on an invoice separately from the transaction and document dates, so the billed revenue posts to the right financial period. This keeps Project Operations and Finance and operations apps in sync, with the same accounting date flowing through f...

item.title: MC1472191: Power Automate - Create and manage custom dashboard tiles
item.description: We are announcing the ability to create and manage custom dashboard tiles in Power Automate. This feature will reach public preview on September 30, 2026. How does this affect me? This feature enables users to monitor the metrics that matter most to their role or team without relying on external tools. By allowing personalized visualizations directly within Automation Center, users can gain faster insights, improve operational visibility, and make more informed decisions. Users can add, edit, de...

item.title: MC1472159: Dynamics 365 Contact Center - Manage overnight shifts as a single continuous schedule
item.description: We are announcing the ability to manage overnight shifts as a single continuous schedule in Dynamics 365 Contact Center. This feature will reach general availability on October 2, 2026. How does this affect me? With this feature, supervisors can now create and manage overnight shifts that span across midnight while maintaining a single continuous shift experience. Activities, breaks, meals, and ad-hoc work can be scheduled anywhere within the overnight shift and remain part of a single continuou...

item.title: MC1472032: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Insights Copilot Analytics cowork adoption impact
item.description: Microsoft 365 Copilot now includes Cowork adoption and impact insights in the Consumption dashboard and Viva Insights Advanced Insights. Available worldwide, these insights help leaders, managers, and analysts track usage, work outcomes, and optimize investments. Enabled by default for eligible roles with no immediate action required.

item.title: MC1472028: Outlook: Change the organizer of meetings
item.description: Microsoft is introducing a feature to change the organizer of eligible Outlook meetings, allowing transfer of meeting ownership within an organization. Phase 1 (late 2026) supports non-online meetings; later phases will add online and Teams meetings. The new organizer must accept the transfer, preserving meeting content and attendee settings.

item.title: MC1472025: Microsoft SharePoint: PowerShell support for brand fonts deletion
item.description: Microsoft SharePoint will introduce the Remove-SPOFontFile PowerShell cmdlet by mid-October 2026, allowing admins to delete brand fonts across geographies. Deleted fonts fallback to Microsoft-defined fonts on sites, while font packages remain with warnings. This requires Public CDN enabled and PowerShell module updates.

item.title: MC1472023: [Outlook Mobile] Purview Data Loss Prevention support for Calendar Events
item.description: Outlook for iOS and Android will support Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention for calendar events, helping prevent sensitive data sharing in meeting details. Rolling out worldwide in late September 2026, this feature requires no admin action and extends existing DLP policies to calendar content for improved compliance.

item.title: MC1472022: [Outlook Mac] Purview Data Loss Prevention support for Calendar Events
item.description: Outlook for Mac will support Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention for calendar events, detecting sensitive info in meeting details to prevent data leaks. Rolling out in late September 2026, it requires no admin action and extends existing DLP policies to calendar content for improved compliance.

item.title: MC1472021: [Outlook Mobile] Purview DLP Wait-on-Send Support
item.description: Outlook for iOS and Android will support Microsoft Purview DLP wait-on-send policies, allowing organizations to require and configure a wait time for DLP evaluation before sending emails. This enhances sensitive data protection and policy enforcement, with rollout starting and completing in late September 2026.

item.title: MC1472019: [Outlook Mac] Purview DLP Wait-on-Send Support
item.description: Outlook for Mac will support Microsoft Purview DLP wait-on-send policies, requiring email evaluation before sending to protect sensitive data. Rolling out in late September 2026, this feature lets administrators set wait times for policy checks, enhancing compliance and security while balancing user productivity.

item.title: RM571297: Microsoft Teams: Report suspicious guest invitations
item.description: Microsoft Teams will enable users to report suspicious guest invitations directly from Teams. When users receive an unexpected or potentially malicious guest invitation, they can report it to their IT admin for review, helping identify and mitigate phishing and other abuse through guest invitations.

item.title: RM568067: Microsoft Teams: See more messages on mobile
item.description: We are introducing a more streamlined messaging experience that displays more content on screen while improving readability when using Teams on mobile. These updates make it easier to scan conversations and follow the discussion flow, helping users stay productive and engaged wherever they work.

item.title: RM489227: Access: Enable zoom magnification to Microsoft Access for Forms, Tables, Queries
item.description: Access will add magnification slider (10% to 500%) in lower right of the application, similar to the feature in Word, PowerPoint, and Excel. It will also be keyboard accessible and available on the ribbon in Access forms, tables, and queries.

item.title: RM501111: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): [Copilot Extensibility] Users in GCC-M will able to use custom engine agents
item.description: Users in GCC-M will be able to use custom engine agents.

item.title: RM561330: Microsoft 365: Introducing Exchange Online Cross-tenant Message Recall
item.description: We're enhancing the Exchange Online Message Recall feature to add support for cross-tenant recalls. Today, you can recall messages only within your organization. Cross-tenant recall will let you recall messages sent to other organizations that add your tenant to their recall allow list.

item.title: RM561491: Outlook: Copilot Settings in classic Outlook for Windows
item.description: You will now be able to access different Copilot settings directly in classic Outlook for Windows.

item.title: RM562991: Microsoft Purview: Endpoint Data Loss Prevention - Allow customer to scope JIT Audit to specific user or user group
item.description: Enable customers to include or exclude users/user groups from Just‑In‑Time (JIT) Audit, ensuring audits are generated only for the selected users or groups.

item.title: RM561856: Access: Zooming for Continuous Forms and Multiple-Items Forms
item.description: Access extends zoom capabilities to continuous forms and pop-up forms, building on zoom support already available in tables and queries. Adjust magnification from 10 percent to 500 percent using the slider in the lower-right corner or controls on the ribbon. Keyboard shortcuts are also available, making it easy to quickly change your view and focus on the details that matter most.

item.title: RM569423: Microsoft Teams: Hide Organizer name in Calendar View on Teams Panels
item.description: Admins can now choose whether the organizer name will show up in the Calendar View on Teams panels. Admins can toggle the "Show organizer name" setting ON or OFF in the Pro Management portal or on the panel device. Based on the selection, the organizer name will or will not be shown in the calendar view on the panel device. Available with Teams Rooms Pro and Teams Shared Space licenses.

item.title: RM562992: Microsoft Purview: Endpoint Data Loss Prevention – Ability to protect files stored in the excluded folders in Windows
item.description: Endpoint DLP now extends protection to files stored in commonly excluded Windows folders, including Temp and AppData. This helps improve coverage by detecting and protecting sensitive data in these locations.

item.title: RM566318: Microsoft 365 app: New Copilot Notebooks design in the Microsoft 365 Copilot App (iOS)
item.description: Copilot Notebooks in the Microsoft 365 Copilot app (iOS) now lets users organize related chats, output creations, and references into a persistent AI workspace. Copilot uses the Notebook's accumulated context to ground responses, so work continues across sessions instead of starting over each time.

item.title: RM567315: Planner: Capabilities in Microsoft Cowork
item.description: You’ll soon be able to bring your Microsoft Planner into Microsoft Cowork. In Cowork, you can view, create, and update your plans, buckets, goals, and tasks without switching apps. Cowork goes a step further by helping you execute your Planner tasks across Microsoft 365, such as drafting and sending emails, scheduling meetings, posting updates to Teams, and working with files. It can then write progress back to Planner with your approval. You can move from planning your work to getting it done i...

item.title: RM561854: Access: Rounded corners on Access form controls
item.description: We’re making it easier to give your Access apps a polished, up-to-date feel. With the new CornerRadius property, you can add rounded corners to form controls—bringing a softer, more modern look to your designs.

item.title: RM566697: OneDrive: PDF annotation for sensitivity-label protected PDFs in the OneDrive apps (iOS and Android)
item.description: The Microsoft OneDrive apps for iOS and Android will let users annotate PDFs protected by a Microsoft Purview Information Protection sensitivity label that applies encryption — without removing or weakening the label. Users with edit/annotate rights can add a full set of annotations — including ink, highlight, free text, notes, signatures, image/shape/date stamps, bookmarks, and form fields — directly in the OneDrive mobile PDF viewer; the file's encryption and usage rights are preserved end to...

item.title: RM571199: Outlook: New Cloud Policy controls
item.description: We’re introducing Cloud Policy service support for Outlook on the web and new Outlook for Windows. Admins can set default values for supported Outlook settings and choose whether users can change them, providing consistent cloud-based control across their organization

item.title: RM567007: Outlook: New Copilot entry point in Classic Outlook
item.description: We've introduced a new experience for Copilot in the apps—a consistent entry point across apps that sits above your work and understands the context beneath it. Rather than scattering touchpoints across the interface, it anchors Copilot as one connected system across Microsoft 365, surfacing relevant actions that help you stay in flow. With this release, we are rolling out this new experience - already available across other Outlook endpoints, as well as in Word, Excel and PowerPoint - to classi...

item.title: MC1440972: Microsoft Edge: Upgraded Copilot new tab page
item.description: Microsoft Edge's upgraded Copilot new tab page integrates Microsoft 365 Copilot chat, web search, and work content into one experience with enhanced chat, compose features, suggested actions, and work cards. Rollout begins late September 2026, enabled via admin policy, requiring a Microsoft 365 Copilot license.

item.title: MC1471876: Take Action: Out-of-band update released to address issues from the September 2026 Windows security update
item.description: Microsoft has identified issues that affect some devices after installing the September 2026 Windows security update, released September 8, 2026. On affected devices, host folder shares might be unavailable in Hyper-V-based Linux virtual machines, Remote Desktop Services might stop responding, which can prevent new sessions from being created and can prevent local and remote sign-in, and some USB Audio Class 1.0 devices might fail in multichannel audio modes. An out-of-band (OOB) update was rele...

item.title: MC1387575: Microsoft Purview | Endpoint Data Loss Prevention: Scope Just-in-time audit by user or group
item.description: Microsoft Purview Endpoint Data Loss Prevention now requires admins to explicitly configure which users or groups are audited under Just-in-time protection, enhancing control and reducing audit noise. Rollout begins mid-December 2026. Admins must update configurations and deploy anti-malware client version 4.18.26060 or later.

item.title: MC1384420: Microsoft Purview | Endpoint Data Loss Prevention - Ability to protect files stored in the excluded folders in Windows
item.description: Microsoft Purview Endpoint DLP will protect sensitive files in previously excluded Windows folders (e.g., AppData) during key egress actions starting mid-December 2026. Admins must update policies, deploy anti-malware client 4.18.26051+, and educate users. Audit mode logs actions; block mode enforces restrictions.

item.title: MC1471964: 30-Day Reminder: Windows 11, version 24H2 and Windows 10 LTSB 2016 reaching end of updates on October 13, 2026
item.description: On October 13, 2026, Windows 11, version 24H2 Home and Pro editions, and Windows 10 Enterprise LTSB 2016 will reach end of updates. After this date, devices running these editions will no longer receive monthly security and non-security preview updates containing protections from the latest security threats. We recommend updating devices running Windows 11, version 24H2 Home and Pro editions to Windows 11, version 25H2 to continue receiving monthly security and quality updates. Enterprise and Ed...

item.description: What and whyIn October 2026, Windows updates will begin Enforcement mode for AD FS Distributed Key Manager (DKM) container ACL hardening. item.title: MC1459133: Microsoft Entra ID: Passkey support for B2B users
item.description: Microsoft Entra ID will support passkey registration and sign-in for B2B users, enabling phishing-resistant MFA using resource tenant passkeys. Rollout begins October 2026, with automatic enablement for eligible users. Administrators should review authentication policies and configurations; no immediate action is required.

item.title: MC1450133: Microsoft Entra: Users can register a passkey or passwordless sign-in as their first multifactor authentication method
item.description: Users can now register passkeys or passwordless sign-in as their first multifactor authentication method in Microsoft Entra, eliminating the need to set up weaker methods first. This change, rolling out in phases from October 2026 to February 2027, aims to increase adoption of phishing-resistant sign-in.

item.title: MC1093912: Microsoft Outlook for iOS/Android: Improved Contacts with profile enrichment and duplicate management
item.description: Microsoft Outlook Mobile (iOS/Android) will unify duplicate contacts and enrich profiles with organizational info, improving contact views. Rollout starts mid-July 2025 and completes by mid-November 2026, with no admin action needed. Users should update to the latest app version after rollout.

item.title: MC1269210: Classic Outlook: Retirement of people card expanded view
item.description: The retirement of the people card expanded view in Classic Outlook was planned to simplify the experience, but this change will not proceed at this time. Users can continue using the expanded view, with no admin action required. Features like local time and org chart details remain in Outlook on the web or New Outlook.

item.title: MC1420901: Notebooks in the M365 Copilot App
item.description: Microsoft 365 Copilot app will introduce updated Notebooks by late September 2026, syncing with OneNote to organize chats, content, and references in a persistent workspace. Users with a Copilot license can access and continue work across both apps without changes to existing data or OneNote Notebooks. No admin action required.

item.title: MC1282567: Create charts on pages with AI in SharePoint
item.description: SharePoint will introduce an AI-assisted Charts web part by mid-2026, enabling page authors with a Microsoft 365 Copilot license to create and edit interactive charts using plain-language prompts. The feature is enabled by default, requires no action to prepare, and maintains existing permissions and policies.

item.title: MC1470901: Microsoft Teams: Enhanced real-time alerting rule management in the Teams admin center
item.description: Microsoft Teams will enhance Real-Time Alerting rule management in the Teams admin center by enabling rule duplication, bulk user uploads, and direct rule deletion. Administrators can monitor up to 500 users for In-Progress Meetings and Calls. These features roll out worldwide starting late September 2026, enabled by default.

item.title: MC1470887: Microsoft Teams: Personal message reminders for chat and channels
item.description: Microsoft Teams will introduce personal message reminders for chat and channel messages in October 2026. Users can set, manage, and receive notifications for reminders privately, improving follow-up and organization. The feature is enabled by default, requires no admin setup, and applies to all Teams users across platforms.

item.title: MC1470885: M365 Copilot: Tell Copilot what you need directly from the Copilot button in Word, Excel, and PowerPoint
item.description: Microsoft 365 Copilot adds a new prompt input directly on the Copilot button in Word, Excel, and PowerPoint for faster, contextual content creation. Rolling out worldwide from September to December 2026 on Windows, macOS, and web, it requires no admin action but updates to training and documentation.

item.title: MC1470884: Microsoft Purview eDiscovery: Select user-owned SharePoint Embedded containers as a data source
item.description: Microsoft Purview eDiscovery will support selecting user-owned SharePoint Embedded containers as data sources for cases, searches, and holds starting mid-September 2026. This enables discovery of content from Microsoft Loop, Copilot Pages, and Notebooks, enhancing compliance investigations without changing permissions. No admin action is required.

item.title: MC1470883: Microsoft Outlook for iPad: Minimize email drafts and return to them later
item.description: Outlook for iPad will allow users to compose emails in a separate window and minimize drafts to return later, enhancing multitasking. This feature rolls out worldwide from mid-September to mid-October 2026, with behavior depending on iPadOS multitasking settings. No admin action is needed.

item.title: MC1470881: Microsoft Purview: Removing pay-as-you-go requirements for Edge for Business DLP unmanaged app protections
item.description: Starting mid-October 2026, Microsoft Purview will remove the pay-as-you-go billing requirement for inline collection and DLP policies protecting unmanaged cloud apps in Microsoft Edge for Business. Existing policies and protections remain unchanged, no action is required, and billing checks will be removed for this scenario.

item.title: MC1470871: Microsoft Graph: User.ReadBasic.All will no longer allow reading user app role assignments and license details
item.description: User.ReadBasic.All will no longer provide access to user app role assignments and license details starting mid-September 2026 to fix a security issue. Applications needing this data must switch to User.Read.All or LicenseAssignment.Read.All permissions and update accordingly to avoid disruptions.

item.title: RM566315: OneDrive: Refreshed Libraries View in OneDrive Web
item.description: We're replacing the existing More places experience in OneDrive Web with a refreshed Libraries view. Users can see more recently accessed libraries, navigate to default document libraries for Teams and favorite SharePoint sites, and use new filtering, sorting, and view options.

item.title: RM566699: Microsoft Viva: Discussion Post Previews
item.description: Discussion post previews allow users to review how their discussion posts will appear before publishing, helping them catch formatting issues, validate content, and post with greater confidence.

item.title: RM566870: OneNote: Suggested Artifact Creation in Copilot Notebooks
item.description: Copilot Notebooks in OneNote now suggests artifacts to create, such as Word documents, Excel workbooks, and PowerPoint presentations, based on Microsoft 365 knowledge and the content in your notebook. Select the suggestion and Copilot will generate the artifact.

item.title: RM567005: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Insights: Copilot Analytics - Cowork adoption and impact
item.description: Deeper insights into Cowork adoption and impact accessible from the new AI Cost dashboard and Copilot dashboard. Includes export capability. All metrics can be queried by analysts with the new AI cost query in advanced insights.

item.title: RM567466: Microsoft Teams: Teams events attendance and engagement report policy
item.description: Teams events will soon have a separate attendance and engagement report policy from the "CsTeamsMeetingPolicy" attendance and engagement report policy. This will permit admins to allow Teams events organizers to access attendance and engagement reports, while restricting access to Teams meeting attendance and engagement reports.

item.title: RM562353: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Session and Response Sharing in M365 Copilot
item.description: Session and Response Sharing let Microsoft 365 Copilot users share Copilot chat content through a link. Session Sharing shares a full chat session, while Response Sharing shares a single Copilot response. The shared content opens as a read-only view, and recipients can continue from it in their own Copilot chat. This gives Copilot users an easier and more controlled way to share useful Copilot outputs with coworkers instead of copying and pasting. It helps teams reuse work, share context, and co...

item.title: RM569420: Microsoft Teams: Coordinated meetings support on Teams Rooms on Android
item.description: Teams Rooms on Android now supports coordinated meetings, enabling paired Teams Rooms on Android devices and Android-based touch boards to work together in the same hybrid meeting experience. This feature enables coordinated join and leave, and collaboration across front-of-room displays and touch boards. This creates more immersive and flexible meeting spaces for both in-room and remote participants.

item.title: RM570646: Microsoft Teams: Organize important resources in chats and channels
item.description: Microsoft Teams is introducing a new way to organize and access important resources in chats and channels. Users will be able to pin key content, including links, files, and messages, directly beneath the chat or channel header for quick access. Resources can also be organized into folders, making it easier to keep important information visible and discoverable in active conversations. This update provides a more consistent experience across chats and channels, helping users stay organized, quic...

item.title: RM570843: Microsoft Teams: Upgraded call history in Teams Calls app
item.description: Call history in the Teams Calls app is being upgraded to make it easier to find and act on past call activity. Missed calls and associated voicemails will be consolidated into a single call history entry, reducing clutter and simplifying follow-up. Call history will also expand from 100 records to up to 3,000 records or 6 months of history, whichever limit is reached first, giving users more context when they need it.

item.title: RM570962: Microsoft Teams: Multi-line call history tabs in the Calls app
item.description: Multi-line users get a redesigned call history experience that organizes activity by phone line. Call activity is organized into dedicated tabs for each line, so history, voicemails, and recordings appear under the line they belong to, making navigation and call management simpler and more intuitive.

item.title: RM570641: Dynamics 365 Field Service: Streamline mobile work with an optimized Subgrid control
item.description: Business Value

item.title: RM570277: Word: Copilot edit mode is available to users in Office 365 GCC
item.description: Edit with Copilot in Word is now available to users in Office 365 GCC, enabling government customers to work with Copilot as a co-creator directly in your document to create, refine, and transform documents more efficiently.

item.title: RM570664: Outlook: Customize the classic ribbon
item.description: You can now customize the classic ribbon by right-clicking the ribbon and choosing which commands and groups appear on the Home and View tabs.

item.title: RM568370: Microsoft 365: [Education] Control access to Learning Activities and Teach
item.description: IT administrators can manage access to Learning Activities and Teach from the Microsoft 365 admin center. Configure Learning Activities separately for educators and for students ages 13 and older and enable or disable Teach for educators to align AI experiences with your organization's policies and deployment readiness.

item.title: RM564605: Outlook: Co-Authoring Highlight and Rewrite
item.description: Users can now collaborate with Copilot to make improvements to email drafts. Select a section of the draft and ask Copilot to make changes, like changing its length, tone, or structure.

item.title: RM566313: OneDrive: Document library views now available in OneDrive
item.description: Users can now work with SharePoint document library views directly from OneDrive. In addition to switching between existing views, users can create and manage views to customize how library content is organized and displayed. This helps teams surface the information that matters most while staying within the OneDrive experience.

item.title: RM561328: Access: Cascading combo and list boxes with LinkMasterFields/LinkChildFields
item.description: Combo boxes and list boxes now support LinkMasterFields/LinkChildFields properties, enabling cascading dropdowns (e.g., Country filters City) without writing VBA code.

item.title: RM560396: Microsoft Purview: Endpoint Data Loss Prevention - Expand protection to Copilot + PC devices for Recall snapshots through custom policies
item.description: Microsoft Purview Endpoint data loss prevention is expanding coverage to Copilot + PCs initially to support Recall snapshots and determining whether policies exist to prevent capture of windows containing restricted sensitivity labels and Sensitive information types (SITs). Purview admins will author Endpoint DLP custom policies to integrate with Windows Copilot + PC Recall setup by Intune admins for Copilot + PC devices exclusively.

item.title: RM559613: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot Chat can now better match search results from Scanned PDFs
item.description: Copilot Chat can now better match search results from Scanned PDFs on Copilot users' files they are working on — content that was previously difficult to search and find.

item.title: RM542181: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Edit with Copilot in Excel (Web, Win32, Mac) - GCC
item.description: Edit with Copilot lets you build and edit workbooks side by side with Copilot. When you're updating budgets, creating financial models, or analyzing data, Copilot uses Excel's most powerful tools like tables, charts, PivotTables, and formulas to help you get the job done.

item.title: RM489232: Microsoft Edge: Adding support for viewing Sensitivity labels applied to a Microsoft Information Protection (MIP) Protected PDF
item.description: Enterprise customers can view sensitivity labels applied to MIP protected PDF to be well informed of the data classification to enable them to handle such sensitive documents. This change will be available in the new PDF viewer on Microsoft Edge.

item.title: MC1458480: Microsoft Edge: Security Update Alerts in the Edge management service
item.description: Microsoft Edge now allows administrators to set severity thresholds for security update alerts, including zero-day fixes, to reduce unnecessary notifications. The feature will roll out worldwide from mid- to end-September 2026 automatically, with no admin action required. Default notifications remain unchanged.

item.title: MC1181769: Microsoft Purview: Integration with Entra GSA Internet Access to enable sensitive file filtering at the network layer
item.description: Microsoft Purview DLP integrates with Entra Global Secure Access Internet Access to filter sensitive files at the network layer, preventing data leaks to unmanaged cloud apps. Public preview starts mid-November 2025; general availability by October 2026. Admins must configure policies, TLS inspection, and activate Purview pay-as-you-go.

item.title: MC1454996: Copilot Chat can float over your Outlook iPad and Mac window
item.description: Copilot Chat in Outlook for Mac and iPad can now pop out into a floating window, allowing users to resize, reposition, and manage it separately from the main Outlook window. The rollout starts late August 2026 and completes by mid-October 2026, with no action required.

item.title: MC1411432: Viva Engage: New post creation experience
item.description: Viva Engage’s post creation experience will be updated by mid-October 2026 with a simpler, more intuitive layout, improved accessibility, and clearer tool organization. No admin action is needed; users should be informed and support materials updated accordingly. Existing capabilities remain unchanged.

item.title: MC1470756: 30-Day Reminder: Windows Server 2022 will reach end of mainstream support on October 13, 2026
item.description: On October 13, 2026, Windows Server 2022 will reach end of mainstream support. The October 2026 security update will be the last mainstream support update available for this version. After this date, Windows Server 2022 will transition to extended support, which includes security updates at no additional cost, and will continue to receive monthly security updates through October 14, 2031. For more information, see the Fixed Lifecycle Policy. Hotpatch update support for Windows Server 2022 Datace...

item.title: MC1413304: Viva Engage: New Recent feed in Home
item.description: Microsoft Viva Engage introduces a new Recent feed in Home for a chronological view of content from followed communities, people, and priority communications, complementing the existing personalized For you feed. It rolls out worldwide from mid-August to early October 2026 with no admin action required.

item.title: MC1455014: Microsoft Teams: Teams Events Attendance and Engagement Report Policy
item.description: Microsoft is introducing a new policy separating Teams Events attendance and engagement report controls from Teams Meetings, managed via CsTeamsEventsPolicy. Rollout starts November 2026. Administrators can independently configure report access with four policy options. Review and update settings and documentation accordingly after rollout.

item.title: MC1469960: Microsoft Exchange Online: Review and configure EWSAllowedAppIDs before Exchange Web Services access changes
item.description: Microsoft is updating how EWSAllowedAppIDs is applied in Exchange Online as part of EWS retirement starting October 1, 2026. Organizations using EWS must review and configure their EWSAllowedAppIDs list to avoid service disruption. Microsoft may generate a list if none exists but won’t overwrite tenant-configured lists.

item.title: MC1470425: Microsoft Copilot Cost Management: September Updates
item.description: September 2026 updates to Microsoft Copilot Cost Management introduce auto-application of new services to spending policies, user spending alerts, expanded and enhanced consumption reporting, custom approval workflows, and improved policy health guidance. Admins should review policies, configure notifications, and familiarize with new reporting features.

item.title: MC1470424: Microsoft Viva Engage: New left navigation controls for collapsing, resizing, and managing favorites
item.description: Microsoft Viva Engage now offers enhanced left navigation controls: users can collapse, resize the pane, favorite unlimited communities, and reorder favorites. These changes improve customization and efficiency, apply across web, Teams, and Outlook, require no admin action, and are available worldwide.

item.title: RM487852: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Realtime voice interactions in Word and PowerPoint
item.description: Use your voice to talk with Copilot, interact in-real time, and understand the content within your document or presentation. Updated September 9, 2026: We will be re-releasing this feature with updates in October. Thank you for your patience.

item.title: RM488142: Microsoft Excel: Extending support for Insights Services to GCC-H and DoD sovereign clouds
item.description: GCC-H and DoD sovereign cloud customers will be able to use features in Excel run by Insights Services, including Analyze Data found on the Data tab.

item.title: RM472030: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Data Lifecycle Management - Retention based on Last Accessed for files in OneDrive and SharePoint
item.description: This creates the ability to apply Retention to each SharePoint or OneDrive item based on when it was last accessed by a user. #copilotcontrolsystem

item.title: RM566527: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management - Ensure regulatory compliance by deleting inactive OneDrives and mailboxes for departing employees
item.description: Enables admins to delete both content and containers for departed users at scale thereby keeping your tenant compliant without any manual effort.

item.title: RM567008: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): New Rich Answer Cards
item.description: Surface new model-driven, dynamically placed Answer Cards across top 7 segments: weather, sports, finance, images, video, places and news for Entra & MSA users across all surfaces.

item.title: RM566858: Microsoft Teams: Clearer text highlighting in dark mode and high contrast mode
item.description: We've improved how highlighted text looks when composing messages in dark mode and high contrast mode, giving you a more consistent editing experience.

item.title: RM570648: Microsoft Teams: Analytics for desk utilization on Teams Pro Management portal
item.description: Teams admins can access utilization analytics for Teams bookable desks on Teams Pro Management portal, similar to analytics provided for meeting rooms on the portal today. For utilization analytics to be enabled, a desk needs to have one or more peripheral device associated, and the desk needs to be licensed with Teams Shared Space license or Teams Shared Space - Single Space license.

item.title: RM570965: Microsoft Purview: Endpoint Data Loss Prevention-Archive File Classification Behavior Change for Windows Endpoints
item.description: We are updating archive file classification behavior on Windows endpoints to align with cloud workloads. This change improves consistency, reduces noise in event reporting, and enhances performance when processing archive files.

item.title: RM570469: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft M365): Copilot Chat can now better match search results from text that appears inside images embedded in Word, Excel, and PowerPoint file
item.description: Copilot Chat can now better match search results from text that appears inside images embedded in Word, Excel, and PowerPoint files is user's working files — such as scanned contracts in Word, screenshots of tables in Excel, or whiteboard photos in PowerPoint — content that was previously difficult to search and find.

item.title: RM553224: Microsoft Viva: Copilot Enhanced Topic Assignment
item.description: We're upgrading our topic assignment pipeline to be powered by Copilot, delivering significantly improved accuracy in categorizing survey comments into relevant topics. Updated August 18, 2026: Rollout timing of this feature is now planned for end of August through early September. We apologize for any inconvenience.

item.title: RM565866: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management - Retention capabilities based on files Last Accessed in OneDrive and SharePoint
item.description: Ability to apply Retention labels and policies to items on OneDrive and SharePoint based on when the items were last accessed by an user.

item.title: MC1470417: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Review PDFs using the Copilot context menu on OneDrive iOS
item.description: Microsoft 365 Copilot on OneDrive iOS lets users select text in PDFs to explain, summarize, translate, or ask custom questions via the Ask Copilot context menu. Rolling out late September to October 2026, it requires a Copilot license and is enabled by default where Copilot is available.

item.title: MC1470416: Microsoft OneDrive and SharePoint: Anchored comments in the PDF viewer
item.description: Microsoft is adding anchored comments to the PDF viewer in OneDrive and SharePoint on the web, enabling users to comment on specific spots or text, collaborate with replies and @mentions, with rollout from mid-October to mid-November 2026, on by default and requiring no admin action.

item.title: MC1470415: Microsoft 365 Copilot in PowerPoint: Guide Presentation Creation with Notes Steering and Strict Brand Adherence
item.description: Microsoft 365 Copilot in PowerPoint introduces Strict Brand Adherence and Notes Steering settings, enabling Brand Managers to ensure presentations strictly follow approved templates and embed guidance in speaker notes. These features enhance brand consistency, reduce manual edits, and require no user action but need Brand Manager configuration.

item.title: MC1470410: Microsoft Teams: QR code protection for messages from external users
item.description: Microsoft Teams will blur QR code images from external users by default starting October 2026 to reduce phishing risks. Users can choose to reveal these images if trusted. No admin action is needed, but user education on QR code safety is recommended. This applies across all Teams platforms.

item.title: MC1282683: Create and edit SharePoint pages with Copilot-powered AI
item.description: SharePoint page editors with a Microsoft 365 Copilot license can now use an AI-powered authoring panel to create and edit pages via natural language prompts, leveraging existing Microsoft 365 content. The feature, rolling out worldwide by September 2026, is enabled by default and allows switching between AI and manual editing.

item.title: MC1466753: Microsoft Word: Similarity Checker retirement
item.description: Microsoft Word's Similarity Checker will be retired on October 3, 2027, and removed from Microsoft Editor. Other writing and editing features, including Microsoft 365 Copilot, remain unaffected. Organizations should review workflows, inform users, and consider alternatives if needed. No action or compliance issues are required.

item.description: Microsoft Purview will soon enable retention policies based on "last accessed" for OneDrive and SharePoint files, starting preview in late November 2026 and general availability in January 2027. This helps delete obsolete data and improves Microsoft 365 Copilot responses, with no admin action needed before rollout.

item.title: MC1469958: Microsoft Purview: Auto-labeling scalability, policy management, and reporting enhancements
item.description: Microsoft Purview Information Protection increases auto-labeling simulation capacity from 4 million to 20 million items, expands SharePoint site targeting, and enhances reporting with Sensitive Information Type summaries and processing charts. Rollout begins September 2026 with no end-user impact or required action.

item.title: MC1430536: Microsoft Purview: Insider Risk Management - Unified alert queue
item.description: Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management is unifying classic alerts and AI-driven triage into a single alert queue, enhancing analyst efficiency with integrated agent insights, filtering, and prioritization. The classic experience will be deprecated by October 2026, with a 60-day transition period and no immediate action required.

item.title: MC1290821: eSignature for Microsoft 365 - Recipient groups
item.description: Microsoft 365 eSignature introduces recipient groups, allowing up to 10 people per recipient slot, where the first signer completes the requirement. This reduces delays in signature workflows, is enabled by default, and rolls out from early September to late October 2026. No admin action needed.

item.title: RM567895: OneNote: Multimodal capture in Copilot Notebooks (Android)
item.description: Multimodal capture enables users to transcribe audio, take images, and type notes in a single session. Copilot then creates a structured Copilot Page with insights and user-captured content, saved to a user-selected Copilot Notebook. Designed for capturing offline work moments—including in-person conversations, whiteboard sessions, and personal notes. This capability is already generally available on OneNote for iPhone and iPad.

item.title: RM570647: SharePoint: Changes to the FAQ web part authoring experience
item.description: The SharePoint FAQ web part will provide a standard, non-AI experience for manually creating, editing, and managing FAQs. The AI-assisted FAQ creation and import will move to the Copilot in SharePoint authoring experience, where authors can use natural-language prompts and selected grounding sources to generate FAQ content that is saved to the compatible FAQ web part. Existing FAQ web parts and their content will continue to render without migration.

item.title: RM570440: Outlook: Inline chat for email drafting
item.description: Instead of opening Copilot Chat every time you want to use Copilot to draft a message, this change introduces an inline chat component that streamlines the process and lets you interact with Copilot without opening the sidebar.

item.title: RM570427: Microsoft Teams: Meeting Shared Files
item.description: The new Meeting Shared Files feature allows users to add relevant files and links to their meeting for easy access and to automatically share that content with all meeting participants. AI in the meeting, like the Facilitator agent, uses these files for targeted grounding to answer questions and enhance skill functionality.

item.title: RM569447: Microsoft Teams: Breakout room support on Teams Rooms on Android
item.description: With breakout room support, Teams Rooms on Android can be added to a breakout room and moved in and out of the main room making it easy for breakout session coordination.

item.title: RM567671: Planner: Planner Agent chat in Basic Plans
item.description: Introducing built-in Planner Agent chat with natural language Q&A, smart task discovery, and in-plan task management.

item.title: RM561204: Planner: My Tasks redesign
item.description: A redesigned My Tasks experience that brings your tasks into one place, making it easier to capture work, prioritize what matters, and stay focused.

item.title: RM562343: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management - Insights and policy recommendations on sensitive M365 data for better Data Security and Compliance posture
item.description: Insights on sensitive M365 data (OneDrive and SharePoint) and recommendations on retention policies for customers to better govern their sensitive data.

item.title: RM561857: Microsoft Viva: Viva Glint - Topic Assignments Included in Comment Report Export
item.description: When exporting comments to spreadsheet from the Comments report, the topic(s) assigned to each comment will be included in the export.

item.title: RM472031: Data Loss Prevention- DLP Policy Change Insights with Security Copilot
item.description: Copilot for Security in DLP can summarize DLP policies. This enhancement enables DLP admins to gain insights on coverage of policies viz. location, classifiers and notifications, and more.

item.title: RM476488: Microsoft Teams: Ability to separate out the Townhall attendee invites
item.description: This backend change will now address the 'separation of attendee' invites from the events crew. This feature allows the organizers of Townhalls to maintain separate invites for attendees.

item.title: RM486828: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Data Lifecycle Management - Apply a retention policy to Microsoft Planner content
item.description: Introducing Data lifecycle management capabilities for Microsoft Planner. Compliance admins can now create a retention policy to manage content located in Microsoft Planner such as tasks for plans associated with an Microsoft 365 Group.

item.title: RM493742: Microsoft Teams: Advanced Collaboration Analytics for GCC
item.description: Advanced Collaboration Analytics for GGC provides Teams admins with insights into external collaboration patterns - covering teams, federated domains, channels, guests, and internal users - along with recommended actions to enhance security for external collaboration.

item.title: RM522616: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Ask Copilot about highlighted response content
item.description: Highlight a sentence, paragraph, or table from the response and ask Copilot to work only on that selection. Get focused explanations, concise summaries, quick translations, or next steps for the exact passage you’re reviewing—no more over broad answers. Your selection is previewed in the prompt so you can edit before you send. It’s a faster, more controlled way to get help right where you’re working.

item.title: RM568364: Microsoft Viva: Rolling out Custom branding in Engage
item.description: Engage is rolling out Custom Branding, a new admin-led capability that lets organizations define a customized, tenant-wide visual identity across the Engage web and mobile apps. Engage-level admins can configure a brand name, add large and small logos, and a theme color that is applied consistently for all users in the tenant. Branding is managed from the new Brand Center in the Viva Engage admin center and helps organizations reinforce their identity throughout the Engage experience.

item.title: RM543713: Microsoft Teams: Call quality feedback surveys for Teams Rooms on Android
item.description: Users can now rate the quality of their calls and meetings and provide additional feedback on calling, video, and screen-sharing experiences to help organizations ensure consistent, high-quality experiences.

item.title: RM561490: Microsoft Teams: Connect Teams meeting to existing Planner Plans
item.description: Teams meetings automatically create a corresponding Planner plan to capture meeting tasks. However, when teams use meetings as their primary collaboration surface for long-running initiatives, tasks from the same project can become scattered across multiple auto-generated plans. With this capability, users can now connect Teams meetings to existing Planner plans, so all related tasks across meetings can be tracked in one place.

item.title: MC1469962: Change in sender email address for Copilot emails
item.description: Microsoft is updating the sender email for Copilot-related educational and enablement emails to microsoftcopilotupdates@microsoft.com by mid-September 2026. Organizations should update mail flow rules and safe sender lists accordingly. The email content remains unchanged, and no tenant action is required for rollout.

item.title: MC1469961: Microsoft Viva Glint: Copilot features are no longer available for cross-tenant guest users
item.description: Starting August 26, 2026, Microsoft Viva Glint's Copilot features will be unavailable to Microsoft Entra cross-tenant guest users due to underlying service limitations. Affected users will no longer see Copilot functionalities, but other Viva Glint features remain unchanged. No admin action or Copilot license assignment will restore access.

item.title: MC1466751: Microsoft Teams: Lobby visibility will align with the "Who can admit from lobby" meeting option
item.description: Starting early September 2026, Microsoft Teams will align lobby visibility with the "Who can admit from lobby" setting, so only those allowed to admit participants can see the lobby. This change improves privacy, is automatic, and may affect meeting workflows involving presenters monitoring the lobby.

item.title: RM499153: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Enhanced personalization with memory in Copilot
item.description: Microsoft 365 Copilot will improve memory in Copilot by increasing the relevance and quality of Copilot responses based on previous communications. This AI-powered capability improves the relevance and quality of Copilot responses by learning from previous communications. These memories are private to the user.

item.title: MC1441784: Microsoft Copilot for Outlook: New Copilot entry point in Classic Outlook
item.description: Microsoft is updating the Copilot entry point in Classic Outlook to a new location next to the ribbon, providing easier access and AI-powered contextual recommendations. The rollout begins late September 2026 worldwide, with no license or admin changes. No action is required, but communication and documentation updates are recommended.

item.title: MC1446797: Microsoft Teams: Modernized Gallery view in Teams Rooms on Android
item.description: Microsoft Teams Rooms on Android will receive a modernized Gallery view starting mid-August 2026, aligning with Windows experience by improving participant visibility, consistent layouts, and meeting display controls. Admins can configure settings; no action is required before rollout. Audio participants will be deprioritized when video is prioritized.

item.title: MC1443518: Microsoft Teams: Expanded presenter visibility in Manage what attendees see
item.description: Microsoft Teams is enhancing presenter visibility in "Manage what attendees see" by allowing event organizers and producers to drag and resize the presenter panel, showing more presenters simultaneously. This improves monitoring, transitions, and management of large events, rolling out from mid-August to late September 2026. No admin action needed.

item.title: MC1462473: Microsoft Teams: PowerPoint Live introduces light mode for presenters
item.description: PowerPoint Live in Microsoft Teams will add a light mode option alongside dark, classic, and high contrast modes for presenters starting September 2026. This update enhances flexibility, accessibility, and personalization without affecting presentation content or attendee views. No admin action is needed.

item.title: MC1429012: Microsoft Teams: Enhanced delegated calling with delegate call access restrictions and join notifications
item.description: Microsoft Teams is adding call delegation enhancements: delegators can lock active calls to block delegate participation and enable warning tones notifying when delegates join or resume calls. These features improve privacy and transparency during calls, rolling out worldwide from August to September 2026. No immediate admin action needed.

item.title: MC1461164: Microsoft Teams Rooms on Android: room users can change the app language
item.description: Teams Rooms on Android will allow users to temporarily change the app language per session from the console, aligning with Windows experience. This feature rolls out from June to October 2026 with app version 2.12.0+, resets after restart, requires no admin action, and does not affect system settings.

item.title: MC1146821: Rewrite with Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat coming soon to Edge for Business users
item.description: Microsoft Edge for Business will roll out the Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat-powered Rewrite feature by late October 2026, enabling users to draft and rephrase text via right-click. It’s enabled by default, respects DLP policies, and can be managed by admins through the InlineComposeEnabled policy.

item.title: MC1009930: Microsoft Teams: Distinguish invites among Attendee, Presenter, and Co-organizer emails
item.description: Microsoft Teams will send separate event invites based on participant roles—Attendee, Presenter, and Co-organizer—allowing organizers to manage distinct invites for town halls. Rollout starts early November 2026, completing by mid-December, with no admin action needed. Users should be informed and documentation updated accordingly.

item.title: MC1459141: Microsoft Teams: Admin policy to automatically block identified external meeting bots from joining meetings
item.description: Microsoft Teams will introduce a new admin policy to automatically block identified external meeting bots from joining meetings, enhancing security. item.title: MC1469565: Microsoft Purview | Data Lifecycle Management - Graph API Support for archive mailboxes
item.description: Microsoft is retiring Exchange Web Services (EWS) in Exchange Online by April 2027 and expanding Microsoft Graph API support for archive mailboxes. Organizations must migrate applications from EWS to Microsoft Graph APIs by October 2026 to maintain archive mailbox access, compliance, eDiscovery, and data lifecycle management.

item.title: MC1469564: Microsoft Publisher: Reminder that support ends in October 2026
item.description: Microsoft Publisher support ends October 1, 2026; it will no longer be available in Microsoft 365 subscriptions. Users should convert or migrate Publisher files to Word, PowerPoint, or Microsoft Create templates before this date. Support for the perpetual version ends October 13, 2026.

item.title: MC1469557: [Whiteboard] Standalone app deprecation (Windows, Mobile)
item.description: Microsoft will retire standalone Whiteboard apps for Windows, iOS, and Android on October 16, 2026. Users must switch to accessing Whiteboard via Microsoft Teams or supported web experiences. Admins should inform users, update resources, and ensure readiness for this transition.

item.title: MC1469555: Microsoft Entra: Optimized passkey registration campaign experience
item.description: Microsoft Entra is enhancing passkey registration campaigns to optimize user experience and increase phishing-resistant authentication adoption. Eligible users will be automatically prompted based on qualifying passkey profiles. Rollout begins early September 2026. Administrators should review campaign configurations and user assignments before rollout.

item.title: MC1469551: Teams admin center device state rules and health alerts retire; use Teams Rooms Pro Management portal
item.description: Teams admin center's device state rules and health alerts will retire by late September 2026. Device health monitoring moves to the Teams Rooms Pro Management portal, which offers unified monitoring and alerting. Admins must reconfigure alerts and integrations in the new portal; end-user experience remains unchanged.

item.description: Extend Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention (DLP) policies to filter sensitive files at the network layer by integrating with Entra Global Secure Access Internet Access. item.title: RM392838: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Data Lifecycle Management - Introduction of secure workflow to bypass legal holds and retention policies
item.description: The first release of Priority cleanup enables admins to create a recurring exception to delete items under a broader retention policy and/or legal hold on Exchange workload. Creating a Priority cleanup will require a separate security role, multiple approvers, and will have a complete audit trail.

item.title: RM550513: Microsoft Clipchamp: Upgraded music selection for Copilot AI Videos
item.description: With a Microsoft365 Copilot license, Copilot AI-generated video projects have improved audio with realistic AI voiceover, professional sound effects, and enhanced audio mixing.

item.title: RM570847: Microsoft Viva: Copilot Analytics - Agent value insights in Agent 365 Dashboard
item.description: Customers can now view value insights in the Agent 365 Dashboard in Microsoft Viva Insights (Copilot Analytics). These insights help business leaders and change and adoption specialists understand not only whether agents are being used, but also the estimated assisted hours agents provide and the types of work contributing to that value.

item.title: RM570845: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention for Microsoft Cowork
item.description: Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention (DLP) is expanding to Microsoft Cowork, enabling data security admins to use a single policy across Microsoft 365 Copilot and Cowork. The integration helps protect sensitive AI interactions by preventing the use of labeled knowledge sources, blocking prompts that contain supported sensitive information types, and restricting sensitive prompts from being sent to Bing for web search.

item.title: RM570668: Microsoft 365: Teams Channel Backup
item.description: A backup and recovery feature that lets you recover team & channel data (like files, messages exchanged over channels) in Microsoft Teams to a previously known good state after accidental changes or security compromises. Supported items include Team, Channels (Standard, Private, Public) and underlying data. Retention period supported is 30 days.

item.title: RM570448: OneDrive: Sync support for up to 1 million items on macOS
item.description: OneDrive Sync supports syncing up to 1 million items on macOS devices, helping teams manage large document libraries and shared content at scale without compromising access across devices. This preview requires the Insiders ring and that devices meet minimum hardware and configuration requirements. Devices that don't meet these requirements continue to sync at the existing 300,000-item supported limit with no disruption.

item.title: RM570429: Microsoft Viva: Viva Glint - Survey taking experience refinements
item.description: This feature is a collection of improvements including updates to the auto-save experience for comments, simplifying survey navigation through buttons by consolidating the "Skip" and "Done" buttons into a single "Next" button, and to give the survey taker greater control over question progression by refining the auto-scroll behavior when updating answers to questions.

item.title: RM547749: Microsoft Viva: Copilot Analytics - Export metrics in the Copilot Dashboard at Day Level
item.description: This feature enables users to export fresher row-level Copilot metrics from the Copilot Dashboard for reporting and deeper analysis at day level. #copilotcontrolsystem

item.title: RM569933: Planner: Task History
item.description: Task History helps keep teams up to date on changes made to a task. View recent activity to see what changed, when it changed, and track progress over time.

item.title: RM568932: Microsoft Teams: Collect information with list form in Workflows
item.description: Starts a workflow with a form to collect the information you need to run the rest of your workflow.

item.title: RM570153: Planner: Add times to task start, finish, and due dates
item.description: Add specific times to task start, finish, and due dates. Define a plan’s time zone and working hours to automatically provide default task times and choose whether to view times in the plan’s time zone or your local time zone. This helps distributed teams coordinate effectively across time zones and keep deadlines clear.

item.title: RM568791: Planner: Refreshed experience and new capabilities
item.description: Microsoft Planner will be updated with a cleaner, more modern interface, improved navigation, responsive layouts, and a more consistent experience across Planner in Teams and Planner for the web. This update also introduces Goals in basic plans.

item.title: RM567319: Outlook: Categorize Emails by Dragging Them onto a Favorite Category
item.description: You can now add a category to your Favorites and then drag emails right onto it to apply that category. No need to open menus or right-click each message. Just pin the category you use most to Favorites, then drop your emails on it to tag them in one quick motion. It's a faster, more visual way to keep your inbox sorted the way you like. #newoutlookforwindows

For example, any number of non‑Microsoft 365 generative AI prompts and responses that collectively amount to 1 GB of retained data will be billed at $0.25 per GB per month (equivalent to ~$0.0082 per GB per day). item.title: RM561035: Microsoft Edge: Allow M365 authentication popups in work profiles

item.description: Users will find updated layouts and text animations on video projects generated with Copilot.

item.description: Starting September 2026, Microsoft will redirect users from m365.cloud.microsoft to copilot.cloud.microsoft. Organizations must ensure network and security controls allow access to copilot.cloud.microsoft to avoid service disruption. Review and update firewall, proxy, and allow lists to permit *.cloud.microsoft traffic before October 2026.

item.title: RM570842: Dynamics 365 Finance: Support requirements of tax reform in Brazil in 2027
item.description: Microsoft plans to introduce additional Globalization Studio capabilities to help support Brazil tax reform requirements, including the new IS tax type, tax assessment capabilities for reformed taxes, expanded fiscal note functionality for additional business scenarios, enhanced tax posting processes, and further updates to CNPJ-related processes. Additional capabilities will continue to be introduced as future phases of Brazil's tax reform are implemented.

item.title: MC1466762: Cross-post SharePoint News to Engage
item.description: SharePoint News can now be cross-posted to Viva Engage communities with full fidelity and unified conversations across feeds, Outlook, Teams, and apps. Rolling out worldwide from late September to October 2026, this feature synchronizes comments and reactions, enhancing content reach without extra effort. Admins should inform users accordingly.

item.title: MC1469329: Build apps in Microsoft Copilot Studio and Copilot Cowork
item.description: Microsoft announces a preview of app-building in Copilot Cowork starting September 8, 2026, with Copilot Studio following soon. Users with licenses can create, test, and publish apps using natural language and organizational data, governed by existing policies and managed via the Microsoft 365 admin center.

item.description: The September 2026 security update is now available for all supported versions of Windows. We recommend that you install these updates promptly.
