item.title: MC1325441: Microsoft Purview | Data Lifecycle Management - Archive SharePoint files under retention
item.description: Microsoft Purview Data Lifecycle Management will add an Archive option to retention policies, allowing admins to move inactive SharePoint and OneDrive files to Microsoft 365 Archive. Archived content remains compliant and discoverable but is excluded from Copilot indexing. Rollout begins September 2026 and requires admin configuration.

item.title: MC1466328: Frontier: [Skills] 'Explain this presentation' built in skill in PPT Copilot (Desktop)
item.description: PowerPoint Copilot's "Explain this presentation" skill, rolling out in September 2026 for Windows desktop, provides users with an impartial summary of presentations, including main ideas, key takeaways, numbers, visuals, speaker notes, and open questions, enhancing understanding without requiring user action.

item.title: MC1467357: Microsoft Teams: Updated header and dashboard for chats and channels on mobile
item.description: Microsoft Teams mobile will feature a redesigned header and lightweight dashboard for chats and channels, improving navigation and access to key details. Rolling out from late September to early October 2026, this update aligns mobile with desktop experience and requires no user action.

item.title: MC1467356: Deprecation for Manifest V2 (MV2) browser extensions support in Microsoft Edge
item.description: Microsoft Edge will retire Manifest V2 (MV2) extensions by early 2027, fully switching to Manifest V3 (MV3) for improved security and performance. MV2 extensions will be disabled, blocked from new installs, and policies supporting MV2 removed. Enterprises must migrate to MV3 before the deprecation deadline.

item.title: MC1467355: Power BI subscriptions: Changes to notification delivery and sender experience
item.description: Power BI is updating subscription notification delivery to improve reliability and sender reputation, changing sender identity, email formatting, and Copilot summary presentation. The phased rollout starts late September 2026 through January 2027. No subscription recreation is needed, but organizations should review mail rules relying on the old sender identity.

item.title: RM558928: Planner: Microsoft Planner tab support for shared and private channels in Microsoft Teams
item.description: Now you can add Microsoft Planner as a tab in shared and private channels in Microsoft Teams, which allows to create and manage tasks directly within the channel.

item.title: RM553215: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Create Videos in the Clipchamp Start Page
item.description: Users can use Copilot to create videos directly from the Clipchamp Start page. Turn a simple prompt or existing document into a polished video in minutes. Copilot will automatically draft a script, selects visuals, add narration, and assembles the video for you—no video editing experience required. Review, refine, and export your video quickly, all in one flow.

item.title: RM561033: Microsoft Purview: Endpoint Data Loss Prevention – Device Health Reporting Dashboard
item.description: This dashboard will allow admins to view the device health across all their devices to ensure the system is healthy and ready to receive policy updates and quickly identify devices that are not ready.

item.title: RM564968: Microsoft Clipchamp: New text and shape animations in the video editor
item.description: Clipchamp Editor will support simple animations for text layers. Users can apply preset in/out animations, adjust how long the animation lasts, choose its direction, and preview the animated text in the editor prior to exporting. This capability will be available across web and native desktop versions of Clipchamp.

item.title: RM566316: OneDrive: Refreshed file browsing and filtering experience in OneDrive Web
item.description: OneDrive is making it easier to find and work with files across Microsoft 365. We're refreshing the filtering experience across OneDrive Web, updating existing filters in views like Home, Shared, People, Meetings, and Favorites to support multiple filters at once, and bringing those same filtering capabilities to folder-based experiences such as My files and shared folders. Users can also filter content by file type using both filter pills and the filter pane.

item.title: RM566317: Microsoft Viva: Create and customize PBI reports
item.description: We are introducing a new feature for leaders and analysts of Viva Insights, where they can view a Power BI report, and edit time range, filters, attributes and change visuals as per their organizations' needs. They can then save the report for viewing later.

item.title: RM567461: Microsoft Teams: Updated header and dashboard for chats and channels on mobile
item.description: You can now get oriented and take action faster when using Teams on mobile, with a redesigned header and lightweight dashboard that brings key channel details, people, and pinned content into one intuitive place. It creates a more predictable, familiar experience across desktop and mobile so you can move faster with less friction.

item.title: RM569209: Microsoft Teams: Add multiple steps when building a workflow from scratch
item.description: You will now be able to add multiple steps to your workflow when building one from scratch.

item.title: RM570439: Microsoft Teams: QR code protection in Teams messaging
item.description: Microsoft Teams will provide additional protection for QR codes shared by external users in messages. Images containing QR codes from external senders will be obscured by default and require users to reveal them before viewing or scanning. This helps reduce the risk of phishing and fraud by encouraging more deliberate interaction with QR code content.

item.title: MC1440968: Microsoft Entra ID: Optimizations for passkey registration experience
item.description: Microsoft Entra ID is optimizing passkey registration to better align with administrator policies, prioritize local device passkeys, and improve successful registrations without UI changes. The rollout begins late August 2026, completing by mid-September. No action is required; organizations should continue promoting passkey adoption.

item.title: MC1387814: Microsoft Teams: RTMP-In port and domain changes required
item.description: Microsoft Teams is updating RTMP-In port and domain requirements to improve streaming reliability. Admins must allow outbound access to ports 50118, 50119, and domain *.rtmpingest.mcr.teams.cloud.microsoft by January 31, 2027. Existing RTMP-In events work until end of 2026; new events require updates to avoid failure.

item.title: MC1403410: Microsoft Viva: Agent flexible query in Analytics Workbench
item.description: Microsoft Viva Insights Analytics Workbench will add a flexible query feature in late September 2026, enabling analysts to explore Microsoft 365 Copilot agent usage with customizable queries. This automatic update requires no admin action and supports data-driven decisions for organizations with over 50 Copilot licenses.

item.title: MC1466864: Call Quality Dashboard Custom Detailed Reports
item.description: Call Quality Dashboard will get a refreshed interface with enhanced accessibility and features like dark mode. Public preview starts mid-August 2026; general availability begins early September 2026. No action is needed, and users can revert to the old experience during rollout.

item.title: MC1466760: Microsoft Copilot Pages: Access existing Pages from the "/" menu in chat
item.description: Starting late August 2026, users can access existing Pages via the "/" menu in Copilot chat, while the "Edit in Pages" menu will focus on creating new Pages. This update streamlines referencing Pages without affecting existing content or permissions. No action is required.

item.title: MC1466757: Microsoft Teams: Collect information with List Form in Workflows
item.description: Microsoft Teams Workflows will add a new trigger, "A form is submitted," for automating actions based on SharePoint list–backed form responses. Rolling out September–October 2026, it enables posting responses in Teams, uses existing SharePoint governance, requires no admin action, and respects current permissions and policies.

item.title: MC1466754: Microsoft Viva Engage: Reducing reply notification volume in email
item.description: Microsoft Viva Engage will reduce email reply notifications by only sending alerts for direct replies, @mentions, and new posts, cutting down on broader conversation notifications. This change, rolling out from September to October 2026, requires no user action and keeps existing settings unchanged.

item.title: MC1466750: Microsoft Secure Score: New AI-readiness recommendations for device security
item.description: Microsoft Secure Score will add four new AI-readiness recommendations for device security in Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, focusing on TPM 2.0, VBS, HVCI, and LAPS. These will help identify and remediate devices lacking key protections, rolling out from early to late September 2026 with no action required to receive them.

item.title: RM570468: Microsoft Teams: Automatic recording and transcription choices align with admin policies
item.description: Meeting organizers will only see automatic recording and transcription choices in Meeting Options that are allowed by their organization's existing meeting policies. A new Record only choice lets organizers automatically start recording without starting transcription. Depending on the organizer's policies, available choices can include Record and transcribe, Transcribe only, Record only, and Off. When both recording and transcription are disabled by policy, the automatic setting is not shown.

item.title: RM516043: Microsoft Edge: PDF Viewer Performance Improvement and Minor Visual Updates
item.description: The PDF Viewer in Microsoft Edge is migrating to WebUI2, enhancing responsiveness and introducing a series of subtle visual upgrades aimed at improving overall usability and utility. This migration ensures UI coherence with the rest of the browser while maintaining the same user experience.

item.title: RM561327: Microsoft Purview: Information Protection- File Labeler and File Viewer for MacOS
item.description: This feature is bringing the Information Protection Filer Labeler and Viewer applications to the MacOS platform. Enabling customers to have the same capabilities available on Mac. Core functionality will be available with the exception of the Advanced label-based protection feature.

item.title: RM568366: Microsoft Edge: Automatically unsubscribe users from notifications sent by scam and malicious sites
item.description: Microsoft Edge now helps further protect users from malicious web notifications. When a notification leads users to a site that Microsoft Defender SmartScreen blocks as a scam, phishing, or malware page, Edge automatically stops that source from sending users further notifications and lets users know. Users can review and restore any of these sites anytime under edge://settings/privacy/sitePermissions/allPermissions/notifications.

item.title: RM570467: Microsoft Teams: Admins can control profanity filtering in meeting transcripts
item.description: Teams administrators will be able to use a meeting policy to control whether profane words are masked in live transcription and saved meeting transcripts. Filtering remains on by default. When an organizer is assigned a policy that turns filtering off, profane words can appear without masking in both the live and saved transcript, while live captions continue to follow each participant's existing profanity setting.

item.title: RM570443: Microsoft Edge: Tab organization enhancements
item.description: Microsoft Edge is expanding tab and Workspace organization capabilities to suggest groupings, names, visuals, and labels. Users can manage these experiences through the proposed “Let Microsoft Edge help keep your tabs organized” setting under Privacy, search, and services > Search and connected experiences; administrators can control them using the TabServicesEnabled policy.

item.title: RM570445: Microsoft Purview: Auto-labeling scalability, policy management, and reporting enhancements
item.description: Microsoft Purview is improving auto-labeling capabilities to help organizations manage and validate labeling policies at enterprise scale. These enhancements expand support for larger SharePoint scopes, improve policy management flexibility, and provide richer visibility into auto-labeling activity.

item.title: RM506749: Microsoft Viva: Copilot Analytics - Agent Dashboard.
item.description: Viva Insights is creating an Agent Dashboard, designed to be a central place for leaders, delegates and analysts to understand how your organization is adopting agents. #copilotcontrolsystem

item.title: MC1438571: Default visibility of additional profile card properties in Microsoft 365 profile cards
item.description: Microsoft 365 will change the default visibility of 11 profile card properties to show by default when populated, starting late September 2026. Administrators can review and hide specific properties using Microsoft Graph APIs before rollout. Visibility remains manageable via admin center post-rollout.

item.title: MC1166852: Microsoft Viva Copilot Analytics launches new agent dashboard
item.description: Microsoft Viva Copilot Analytics introduces a new Agent Dashboard for tracking agent adoption and Copilot credit usage, rolling out publicly in early February 2026 and generally available by late October 2026. It offers detailed metrics, retention trends, and top agent insights, enhancing the Copilot Dashboard's Adoption tab.

item.title: MC1323270: Microsoft Teams: Secure Reliable Transport (SRT) support for Teams meetings and events
item.description: Microsoft Teams will support Secure Reliable Transport (SRT) for town halls and live events starting June 2026, offering improved reliability and backup stream failover alongside existing RTMP. No user impact; admins must enable SRT in meeting policies and update event production processes accordingly.

item.title: MC1257308: Microsoft Teams: Building‑level insights on the Teams Rooms Pro Management portal recommended actions page
item.description: Microsoft is adding building-level insights to the Teams Rooms Pro Management portal's recommended actions page, helping IT identify buildings with high Teams Rooms usage but still have BYOD rooms. This feature, enabled by default for eligible licenses, rolls out mid-June to mid-September 2026 to improve meeting consistency.

item.description: PowerPoint for the web will roll out an "Explain this presentation" skill in September 2026, providing users with an impartial summary of slides, charts, notes, key takeaways, numbers, visuals, and open questions to help understand presentations faster. A Copilot license is required.

item.title: MC1466326: Frontier: [Skills] 'Explain this presentation' built in skill in PPT Copilot (Mac)
item.description: PowerPoint for Mac will roll out the "Explain this presentation" skill in September 2026, providing users with an impartial summary of slides, charts, notes, and key data to help understand presentations faster. No action is required, but a Copilot license is needed.

item.title: MC1466323: Frontier: Skills] 'Sharpen slide titles' built in skill in PPT Copilot (Desktop)

item.description: PowerPoint for Mac will get the "Sharpen slide titles" skill in early September 2026, rewriting slide titles as clear takeaways to enhance impact. No admin changes needed, but a Copilot license is required. Inform help desks and update training materials accordingly.

item.description: PowerPoint for the web will get a new Copilot skill, "Sharpen slide titles," in early September 2026, which rewrites slide titles as clear takeaways. No admin changes are needed, but a Copilot license is required. Inform help desks and update training materials accordingly.

item.title: MC1326509: Microsoft Purview: Information Protection- File Labeler and File Viewer for MacOS
item.description: Microsoft Purview Information Protection is introducing File Labeler and File Viewer apps for macOS, enabling sensitivity labeling and protected file viewing like on Windows. Public preview starts May 29, 2026, with general availability on November 30, 2026. Advanced label-based protection is not supported initially.

item.title: MC1466307: Microsoft Teams: Centralized notification settings for channels
item.description: Microsoft Teams will introduce centralized channel notification settings, allowing users to manage all channel notifications from one location. This feature, enabled by default, rolls out worldwide in October 2026, preserves existing settings, requires no admin action, and aims to simplify notification management.

item.title: MC1466302: Project Online Essentials reaches End of Life on October 1, 2026: Action required
item.description: Project Online Essentials will reach end of life on October 1, 2026. Organizations must transition users to supported licenses like Project and Planner Plan 1 or Plan 3 before then to maintain access and licensing rights for Project Online, Project Server, and Planner Premium capabilities.

item.title: MC1466299: Microsoft Planner: New Planner usage report in the Microsoft 365 admin center
item.description: A new Planner usage report in the Microsoft 365 admin center, launching September 2026, provides admins with tenant-level and user-level Planner activity data, including active users and usage trends for basic and premium plans. It includes identifiable user info, requires no action, and supports compliance and reporting needs.

item.title: MC1466296: Microsoft Teams: Report security concerns in meetings
item.description: Microsoft Teams will introduce a "Report a concern" feature in meetings by late 2026, allowing users to report suspicious behavior like phishing or scams. Reports, including meeting metadata, will be accessible to administrators via Microsoft Defender and Teams admin center for investigation and response. This feature is enabled by default.

item.title: RM562050: Microsoft Teams: Support human interpreter listening mode in Microsoft Teams Rooms on Windows
item.description: Microsoft Teams Rooms on Windows now supports human interpreter listening mode in meetings where organizers enable language interpretation in Meeting options, allowing room participants to select a language and hear interpreter audio.

item.title: RM561604: Microsoft Teams: Chat panel open by default in the gallery view on Teams Rooms on Android
item.description: The chat panel will open by default in gallery view, allowing participants in Teams Room on Android to quickly see ongoing meeting chat when they join. Admins can configure this default device behavior, and users can close the panel in one tap during meetings.

item.title: RM561486: Microsoft Edge: Improved website compatibility with site troubleshooting controls
item.description: Microsoft Edge is introducing improvements to help users quickly resolve website issues directly from the browser. When a site is not functioning as expected, users may be guided to relevant troubleshooting options such as adjusting tracking prevention settings (e.g., Strict mode) and reviewing site-specific configurations. This experience surfaces relevant actions in-context to help users restore site functionality without navigating deep into settings.

item.title: RM560820: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management – Increase in expansion limit for auto expanding archive beyond 1.5TB
item.description: Previously, auto expanding archive mailbox expansion was supported only up to 1.5 TB, after which mailboxes would become inoperative. Archive mailboxes can now automatically expand beyond the 1.5 TB limit, ensuring uninterrupted retention and enabling scalable archive growth as storage thresholds are reached. This capability to expand archive beyond 1.5 TB will be available to customers with eligible E5 licenses.

item.title: RM564617: Microsoft Purview: Information Protection - Rights Management connector – Certificate-based authentication
item.description: The Microsoft Rights Management (RMS) connector is moving from shared-secret authentication to certificate-based authentication, improving its security posture. With this update, administrators configure their own Microsoft Entra app registration and certificate, then use the new PowerShell module to configure the certificate for each workload (Connector, Exchange, SharePoint, and FCI). New PowerShell cmdlets handle certificate import, registry configuration, private-key permissions, and validat...

item.title: RM561031: Microsoft Teams: Enhanced bookable desk experience with Teams panel-based desk dock devices
item.description: Users have better experiences in flexible work environments with Microsoft Teams panel-based desk dock devices coming later this year. The Teams panel app now enables devices, such as the Yealink Linkhub, to enhance bookable desk experiences by indicating at-a-glance availability and letting visitors book directly on the device. Each device requires a Teams Shared Space license.

item.title: RM565131: Microsoft Teams: Multi-line Calling on Teams Mobile
item.description: Make and receive calls using multiple assigned phone numbers directly from your mobile device - choose the right line for every call, with unified call history and seamless switching across all your lines.

item.title: RM569214: Microsoft Teams: Copilot Chat for chats, channels, calls, and meetings in GCC, GCC High, and DoD
item.description: Copilot Chat will soon be available across chats, channels, calls, and meetings, helping users stay informed and catch up quickly.

item.title: RM565215: Microsoft Teams: Automatic recording and transcription for Teams Call Queues
item.description: Administrators can enable automatic recording and transcription for Teams call queues. When enabled, calls answered by calling representatives are automatically recorded without manual action. Admins configure the feature per queue via Teams admin center or PowerShell, with controls for recording, transcription and agent access to recordings. Recordings are stored in SharePoint and available through the Queues app call history. Note: Queues app requires a Teams Premium license.

item.title: RM564912: Microsoft Teams: New room optimization mode user experience in Teams desktop
item.description: Users can more easily use their laptop for meetings and collaboration in spaces like focus or huddle rooms that don’t yet have a Teams Rooms system. The new room optimization mode replaces shared display mode, has a new location, and enables or disables room-specific features. When room peripherals are connected, Teams can automatically select audio and video devices, enable speaker recognition and shared display, and disable voice isolation.

It follows the standard two‑step Exchange Migration Service pattern: an initial analysis phase to validate and assess PST data, followed by execution of the actual migration. item.title: RM568372: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention - SLA Based Alert Reporting Dashboard
item.description: Out-of-box MTTA/MTTD/MTTR SLA Alert Reporting dashboard showing past trends, Top SITs getting exposed via DLP alerts generated. Customers can define their custom SLAs for high, med and low severity alerts and get access to dashboard showing operational performance and SLA metrics.

item.title: RM569609: Microsoft Teams: Report a Message or an External User for Security Concern in Gov Clouds
item.description: Users in Gov clouds can now report suspicious messages and external users within Teams. Reports are surfaced in the Teams admin center, giving admins greater visibility into potentially malicious activity and enabling them to investigate and take appropriate action. By incorporating end-user reports as an additional security signal, this capability helps organizations identify and respond more quickly to phishing, impersonation, spam, and other messaging threats.

item.title: RM560823: Microsoft Edge: Work Search Banner for Google
item.description: When a user performs a search on google.com from a work profile, Microsoft Edge can detect whether organization-specific results are available for that query. When relevant results are found, a banner is shown with a link to explore those work results with Microsoft 365 Copilot. This builds on the existing experience already available on Bing and extends it to Google, helping users seamlessly access work-related information regardless of their search engine. Admins can control access to this fea...

item.title: RM569474: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Introducing an App- and Intent-First Agent Creation Experience
item.description: Copilot Studio is evolving to an app-first agent creation experience. Makers start with the application their agent will work with and configure the capabilities it needs. This update brings tools and knowledge into a more unified experience, simplifying how agents are created and configured.

item.title: RM570433: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Deliver rich interactive app experiences in Copilot Studio agents
item.description: Copilot Studio agents can now render rich, interactive UI inline using MCP Apps, an extension of the Model Context Protocol. When an agent calls a UI-enabled tool from a compatible MCP server, interactive experiences like sortable tables and drilldowns render directly in the conversation. Users can now explore and act on data without leaving the chat or switching tools. item.title: RM564614: Microsoft Teams: Meeting recap app
item.description: The meeting recap app brings all your meeting recaps into one place, making it easier to find, filter, and catch up. Quick filters help you surface the right meetings instantly, while audio recap lets you efficiently review multiple meetings at once. You can also browse and revisit any recap from the past 30 days.

item.title: RM560323: Microsoft Teams: Profanity filter is disabled by default for captions
item.description: We are updating the default profanity filter setting for live captions from On to Off across Teams meetings, calls, events, and Microsoft Teams Rooms (MTR) devices to improve accessibility and align with EU requirements. This change will only affect users who have never configured their live captions profanity filter preference. Users who have already set their preference will keep their current setting. item.title: RM559608: Microsoft Teams: Quick access to read items from unread-only view
item.description: Teams chat and channel lists can be filtered to show unread items only. When this filter is applied, hovering over a section reveals an eye icon next to the section name. Selecting the eye icon opens a list of read chats or channels within that section, allowing you to open them without leaving the unread-only view.

item.title: RM559617: Microsoft Purview: Purview in Microsoft Admin Center
item.description: AI and IT admins in Microsoft Admin Center can 1) gain visibility around oversharing risks and drive remediations 2) Understand how much of sensitive copilot interactions are protected and turn on Purview DLP for M365 Copilot right from there. Enables secure adoption of Copilot. Updated September 1, 2026: We are not moving forward with this change at this time. We apologize for any inconvenience.

item.title: RM422324: OneNote: Summary and Q&A in OneNote Mobile with Copilot (Iphone)
item.description: With this new Summary feature in OneNote mobile, you can create a short and fluent summary of your longer pages which will help to consume relevant information faster. With the Question and Answer at your fingertips, you can get real-time answers to your queries directly within your notes, enhancing your ability to access and utilize information quickly and effectively. We inadvertently marked this item as rolling out and now have updated it to be accurate. We apologize for any inconvenience.

item.title: RM495002: Microsoft Teams: Slash commands for apps
item.description: You can now interact with your favorite apps directly from Teams chat and channels compose box using slash commands. Type / and start interacting with Apps and Agents, invoke workflows and more.

item.title: RM529850: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Meeting Prepare from Up Next
item.description: Get timely reminders in Outlook mobile to prepare for your meetings with Copilot. The Up Next card now offers a Prepare option so you can get ready with one tap.

item.title: RM530578: Microsoft Edge: Tracking prevention when browsing InPrivate
item.description: Microsoft Edge is unifying the tracking prevention experience for non-InPrivate and InPrivate browsing windows. Microsoft Edge will use the same tracking prevention setting as a normal browsing window when in InPrivate mode.

item.title: RM494839: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Scanner data export for custom reporting
item.description: Learn about the state of your scanned repositories and create custom reports with the information protection scanner. Labeling, classification and protection actions on scanned files are stored in SQL tables that form a foundation to feed into custom reports.

item.title: RM555235: Microsoft Teams: One-stop admin portal for Teams devices with Teams Rooms Pro Management
item.description: Admins now have a one-stop portal for inventory, health monitoring, management, and analytics for both Windows and Android devices with the Pro Management portal. Management of all Android Teams rooms, panels, and phone devices are transitioning to this portal from the Teams admin center, enabling easy, consistent, and secure management of Teams devices across all operating systems and manufacturers.

item.title: RM558679: Microsoft Teams: Standardized preview experience for Word, PowerPoint, and Excel files
item.description: Microsoft Word, Microsoft PowerPoint, and Microsoft Excel files now open in a standardized preview in Teams on Android and iOS, delivering faster performance, improved reliability, and a more consistent viewing experience.

item.title: RM558852: Microsoft Teams: Digital signage support for Teams panels
item.description: Digital signage can now be displayed on idle Teams panel devices, similar to digital signage support for Microsoft Teams Rooms front of room displays. Signage source and settings can be configured in the Pro Management portal. Available with Teams Rooms Pro or Shared space-licensed spaces.

item.title: RM409534: Microsoft Teams: Local PTZ for Microsoft Teams Rooms on Windows
item.description: Microsoft Teams Rooms on Windows will provide native Pan-Tilt-Zoom (PTZ) controls for connected cameras that support this capability, whether the camera moves a physical lens or adjusts the image digitally. Controls are available when Teams Rooms can confirm the camera isn't independently framing the room.

item.title: RM422323: OneNote: Summary and Q&A in OneNote Mobile with Copilot (Android)
item.description: With this new Summary feature in OneNote mobile, you can create a short and fluent summary of your longer pages which will help to consume relevant information faster. With the Question and Answer at your fingertips, you can get real-time answers to your queries directly within your notes, enhancing your ability to access and utilize information quickly and effectively.

item.title: RM545896: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Structured Document Generation with Forms
item.description: Structured Document Generation with Forms enables organizations to create, manage, and generate standardized documents at scale with built-in governance and compliance in SharePoint. Business process owners can centrally build and maintain form-driven templates -- such as contracts, agreements, proposals, and HR documents -- ensuring content stays accurate and up to date. Users can then generate the right document every time by just filling out the form, without manual formatting, versioning iss...

item.title: MC1459138: Microsoft Teams: Local Pan-tilt-zoom (PTZ) controls for Microsoft Teams Rooms on Windows
item.description: Microsoft Teams Rooms on Windows will add native local Pan-Tilt-Zoom (PTZ) camera controls for compatible cameras, allowing users to adjust cameras directly from the room console. Rollout begins September 2026, with no action required. Administrators should inform users and update support materials accordingly.

item.title: MC688109: Co-organizer experience updates in Teams Webinars and Townhalls
item.description: Co-organizers in Teams Webinars and Townhalls can now fully manage events, including editing details, publishing, and canceling, achieving parity with organizers. Rollout starts mid-January 2025 for targeted release and mid-June 2026 for general availability, with no preparation needed.

item.title: MC1332816: Scoped SharePoint search in Teams (SharePoint app, also called Viva Connections)
item.description: Starting late June 2026, Teams' SharePoint app (Viva Connections) search will be scoped to SharePoint content, showing relevant results and suggestions within Teams. The feature is enabled by default, respects existing permissions, requires no admin changes, and will complete rollout by mid-September 2026.

item.title: MC1324280: Assign open shifts in Microsoft Teams Shifts
item.description: Microsoft Teams Shifts introduces "Assign open shifts," enabling managers to auto-assign open shifts based on availability, time off, and scheduling rules. Rolling out worldwide from mid-June to mid-September 2026, the feature is optional and allows review before publishing. No action required from users.

item.title: MC1317836: Microsoft Teams: Unblock users to send message while file is uploading in the background
item.description: Microsoft Teams will allow users to send messages while files upload asynchronously in the background, improving real-time collaboration. The rollout starts early August 2026 for targeted release and mid-September 2026 for general availability, with no changes to compliance or file storage. No action is required.

item.title: MC1316231: Microsoft Teams: Front-of-room view control for Webinars and structured meetings in Teams Rooms on Android
item.description: Microsoft Teams Rooms on Android will default front-of-room displays to attendee view during webinars and structured meetings starting mid-June 2026, completing by mid-September. Presenters keep full control via console, no impact on remote attendees, and no configuration needed. A Teams Rooms Pro license is required.

item.title: MC1307982: Microsoft Teams Town halls: Upload custom backgrounds in Manage what attendees see
item.description: Microsoft Teams will allow organizers and presenters of town hall events with Teams Premium licenses to upload custom background images in the "Manage what attendees see" feature. This rollout begins early June 2026, enhancing branded visuals behind presenters and shared content in supported layouts.

item.title: MC1250273: Improved copy and paste support for @mentions and shared contacts in Microsoft Teams
item.description: Microsoft Teams will improve copy-paste support for @mentions and shared contacts by preserving interactive tags when valid in the destination. If invalid, tags revert to plain text with original display. Rollout occurs May to mid-September 2026 across platforms, requiring no admin action and enhancing messaging consistency.

item.title: MC1251206: Microsoft Teams: Identify external bots joining your Teams meetings
item.description: Microsoft Teams will detect and label external meeting assistant bots attempting to join meetings, giving organizers control to approve, deny, or remove them. This feature rolls out from mid-May to mid-September 2026, with admin policies to manage bot handling enabled by default for all tenants.

item.title: MC1261595: Microsoft Teams town halls now support backup Real-Time Messaging Protocol (RTMP) streams
item.description: Microsoft Teams town halls will support a backup RTMP stream to improve reliability for large live events. If the primary stream fails, Teams automatically switches to the backup without affecting attendees. Rollout starts late April 2026 and completes by mid-September 2026, requiring no admin action.

item.title: MC1256307: Microsoft Teams: Recently used emojis sync across devices
item.description: Microsoft Teams will sync recently used emojis and reactions across all devices by mid-July to mid-September 2026, providing a consistent emoji experience. The feature is enabled by default, requires no user action, and does not affect data flow, compliance, or existing admin settings.

item.title: MC1197146: Express voice enrollment in Microsoft Teams
item.description: Express voice enrollment in Microsoft Teams enables quick voice profile registration for enhanced features like speaker recognition and improved transcripts. Rolling out mid-June to mid-September 2026 for commercial tenants (excluding EDU), it is ON by default but can be managed or disabled by admins via PowerShell settings.

item.title: MC1045221: Microsoft Teams: New user setting to view incoming calls in a small window
item.description: Microsoft Teams will introduce a new default setting allowing users to view incoming calls in a small, resizable window to reduce disruptions. This feature will roll out from May 2025 to mid-September 2026 across all platforms, requiring no admin action but user notification is recommended.

item.title: MC1459131: Microsoft Teams: Prepare custom apps for private and shared channel compatibility
item.description: Microsoft Teams will roll out a feature by mid-September 2026 to help admins identify custom line-of-business apps needing updates for private and shared channel compatibility. Updating these apps ensures business continuity, reduces support issues, and maintains app access across evolving channel experiences.

item.title: MC1454108: Microsoft 365 Copilot app update: Simpler Copilot access
item.description: Microsoft 365 Copilot app is updating to a unified app for personal and work accounts with clearer visual cues, a simpler name and icon, and a new web URL (copilot.cloud.microsoft). Rollout begins mid-August 2026, with no changes to security, compliance, or enterprise controls.

item.title: MC1455013: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management- Azure PST Import
item.description: Azure PST Import enables Microsoft 365 admins to import PST files from Azure Blob Storage into Exchange Online mailboxes using PowerShell. The process includes readiness analysis, import execution, and compliance auditing. Rollout begins December 2026, requiring specific Azure permissions and mailbox prerequisites, with no direct user impact.

item.title: MC1281505: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management- Azure PST Import
item.description: Azure PST Import enables Microsoft 365 admins to import PST files from Azure Blob Storage into Exchange Online mailboxes via PowerShell. It includes readiness validation, reporting, and audit logging. Rollout starts mid-October 2026 (public preview) and early December 2026 (worldwide). No GUI; admin-driven process.

item.title: MC1454113: Microsoft Copilot Word: Document summarization experience moving
item.description: Starting September 2026, Microsoft Word's document summarization will move from the Top of Doc experience to other Copilot surfaces, maintaining the same AI-powered capability. Users can generate summaries via Copilot prompts. No admin action is needed, but user communication and training updates are recommended.

item.title: MC1422060: Microsoft Defender for Office 365: Prompt injection protection for email
item.description: Microsoft Defender for Office 365 will introduce prompt injection protection for email, detecting and quarantining malicious content targeting AI assistants. Rolling out from July to October 2026, it affects organizations with Defender Plan 2 or Microsoft 365 E5, enabling automatic high-confidence threat quarantine by default with no required action.

item.title: MC1405506: Microsoft OneNote: Multimodal recording in Copilot Notebooks on Windows
item.description: Microsoft is introducing multimodal capture in OneNote Copilot Notebooks on Windows, allowing users to record audio, images, and notes together. Copilot generates summaries and action items from this content. The feature rolls out worldwide from late September to mid-October 2026, requires a Microsoft 365 Copilot license, and can be disabled by admins.

item.title: MC1307979: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Copilot chat pane and Summary feature in OneNote Mobile (iPhone)
item.description: Microsoft 365 Copilot introduces a new chat pane and Summary feature in OneNote Mobile (iPhone) for users with Copilot (Premium) licenses, enabling AI-generated summaries and Q&A on notes. Rollout begins late September 2026, with existing Copilot controls and compliance policies applying.

item.title: MC1309746: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Copilot chat pane and Summary feature in OneNote Mobile (Android)
item.description: Microsoft 365 Copilot introduces a new Copilot chat pane with a Summary feature in OneNote Mobile (Android) for users with Copilot (Premium) licenses. Rolling out late September to mid-October 2026, it enables generating summaries and asking questions about notes, with existing Copilot policies applying.

item.title: MC1247902: SharePoint: AI citations analytics for documents and pages
item.description: SharePoint will add AI copilot citation analytics for documents, pages, and news posts, showing how often content is referenced by Microsoft 365 Copilot chat. Available to tenants with over 50 Copilot licenses, rollout starts end of August 2026. No admin action is needed; site owners get new usage insights.

item.title: RM558539: Microsoft Teams: Enhanced cross-platform join via SIP for Teams Rooms on Android
item.description: Enable Teams Rooms on Android to join third-party meetings via SIP, delivering seamless cross-platform interoperability. This capability ensures users can connect to external meeting services directly from Teams Rooms, maintaining a consistent and reliable meeting experience across diverse environments. Available on Teams Rooms Pro license.

item.title: RM560702: Microsoft Teams: Security Detection Report in Teams Admin Center
item.description: A new Security Detection Report in the Teams admin center provides a centralized view of messaging security detections, including impersonation, malicious URLs, and weaponizable file types. Admins can review detection activity in one place and export detailed data to support investigation and response. This capability helps consolidate security signals for Teams messaging scenarios.

item.title: RM561914: Microsoft Teams: Mandatory pre-meeting consent
item.description: We are providing a new configuration experience in Teams Admin Center where tenant admins can enable and customize an explicit consent message before joining any meeting hosted in their organization.

item.title: RM561038: SharePoint: Admin Center - detailed report on Everyone except external user permissions
item.description: The new report provides SharePoint Advanced Management admins complete item level details of permissions granted to Everyone except external user and Everyone special SharePoint groups.

item.title: RM561026: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Generate documents using forms in SharePoint with Power Automate
item.description: We are introducing a new Power Automate action that enables automated document generation using document generation (DocGen) forms in SharePoint.

item.description: Enable aggregation of DLP alerts based on common entities user even when multiple rules are matched. item.title: RM567891: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Power BI integration in M365 Copilot
item.description: This release enables M365 Copilot to reason over Power BI enterprise data and returns grounded answers directly from Power BI reports and semantic models. Users can ask natural‑language questions and receive accurate answers.

item.title: RM566201: Microsoft Teams: Block all identified external bots automatically from joining your meetings
item.description: Extending the admin controls provided for managing external AI bots and regulating their access to your meetings, we are adding the option to automatically block all identified bots.

item.title: RM566866: Planner: Task Details Side Pane experience
item.description: The Task Details Side Pane lets you view and edit task details in a side pane while keeping your Board, Grid, or My Tasks view visible. Update tasks without losing context or switching back and forth from modal dialogs.

item.title: RM567469: Microsoft Teams: PowerPoint Live Light theme support
item.description: Presenting PowerPoint slides in Teams just got better. PowerPoint Live now supports light mode, giving presenters the option to present in light, dark, classic, or high contrast mode based on their preferences and system settings.

Navigate to the call record in the Queues app and select the Recap tab to access.

item.title: RM566322: OneNote: Multimodal capture in Copilot Notebooks (Windows)
item.description: Capture on Windows helps you bring conversations and ideas from meetings, brainstorming sessions, and everyday work into Copilot Notebooks. item.title: RM498640: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Capture voice notes in the Microsoft 365 Copilot mobile app
item.description: With a Microsoft 365 Copilot license, transform offline discussions into structured, actionable, and searchable content with voice notes in Copilot.

item.title: RM557675: Outlook: Share Word, Excel, and PowerPoint local files via the new Outlook for Windows
item.description: When working in an open Word, Excel, or PowerPoint file, users will now be able to send a copy of the locally stored file by email through the new Outlook for Windows. #newoutlookforwindows

item.title: RM503955: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Updates to Memory and Personalization in Microsoft 365 Copilot
item.description: Copilot now uses chat history to provide more relevant, contextual responses. Updated settings make it easier to view and manage what Copilot remembers and your personalization preferences.

item.description: Microsoft Places features will now be available in GCC cloud

item.title: RM487836: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Employee Self-Service Agent in M365 Copilot
item.description: The Employee Self-Service Agent in M365 Copilot expedites answers for the most common workplace policy-related questions and takes action on key HR and IT related tasks, connecting employees to authorized knowledge bases and HR/IT systems of record for faster resolution time and a streamlined employee experience.

item.title: RM386901: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Information Protection - Sensitivity label grouping modernization
item.description: To help improve label usability and configuration, the sensitivity labeling scheme will be simplified to only consist of labels and label groupings. These new label groupings allow admins to better organize and categorize their labels (previously done via parent labels).

item.title: RM392328: Microsoft Teams: Chat for organizers and presenters in structured meetings and webinars
item.description: Organizers, co-organizers, and presenters can chat privately in a separate chat from attendees. This chat is available to access before, during, and after the event.

item.title: RM508524: Outlook: User-initiated Copilot insights in classic Outlook
item.description: Users can manually select text and ask Copilot to help provide relevant information.

item.description: Enable extended 30-day backup and recovery for a tenant's Entra objects via the Microsoft 365 Backup native app or M365 Backup Storage platform APIs. item.title: RM568784: Microsoft Defender for Identity: Unified identity timeline on the Identity page
item.description: The updated identity timeline provides security teams with a single chronological view of activity and alerts associated with an identity and its linked accounts. It normalizes activity from integrated Microsoft security products, including Microsoft Entra sign-ins, Microsoft Graph audit events, SaaS and cloud activity, and device logons. New fields and filters include Source table, Session ID, and Unique token identifier, with expanded Conditional Access and event context.

item.title: RM569424: Excel: Excel canvas
item.description: A Copilot-generated canvas that turns workbook data into a polished, interactive view of key visualizations, metrics, and insights. As workbook data changes, it automatically updates to reflect the latest information. Users can modify the canvas by chatting with Copilot.

item.title: RM569477: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention – Default Protection Controls for Exchange Online in the event of classification failure
item.description: Default protection controls for Exchange Online is available in public preview. This release gives administrators fine-grained control to create DLP policies based on specific classification or text extraction failure types — such as timeout, throttling and other scan errors — rather than one blanket policy for all failure conditions.

item.title: RM569446: Microsoft Entra: Enhanced Security Accounts Manager (sAM) Account Name support for Microsoft Entra Domain Services
item.description: Enhanced support for synchronizing the Security Accounts Manager account name (sAMAccountName) with Microsoft Entra Domain Services is now in Public Preview. This feature allows sAMAccountName to be populated from the onPremisesSamAccountName attribute in Microsoft Entra ID. item.title: RM570428: Microsoft Viva: Viva Insights and Copilot Analytics in GCC-High
item.description: Microsoft Viva Insights and Copilot Analytics are coming to Microsoft 365 Government Community Cloud High (GCC High), providing eligible organizations with privacy-protected, role-based analytics experiences to help them understand Microsoft 365 Copilot adoption, usage, and impact. Viva Insights also provides data-driven behavioral insights into how employees collaborate, helping organizations improve productivity and wellbeing within the GCC High environment.

item.title: RM570431: Microsoft 365: Organizational Data Service is now available in GCC-High
item.description: We’re excited to announce that Microsoft 365 Organizational Data Service is now available in the GCC-High (GCC-H) environment! item.title: RM570434: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Enabling makers to require human approval for tool calls
item.description: Copilot Studio now let’s makers require human approval before an agent runs specific tools. With a per-tool, per-agent toggle, any gated tool call pauses and shows an approval request describing what the agent intends to do, so a person can approve, approve for the session, or deny before the action runs. This gives organizations a deterministic guardrail for high-stakes or sensitive operations like sending emails, closing tickets, or processing payments, independent of the agent's instructions....

item.title: RM570435: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Streamlining experiences from Copilot Studio Agents in Microsoft 365 Copilot
item.description: This update is meant to bridge the experience of using Copilot Studio agents in M365 Copilot with the Copilot Chat experience. With these updates, agent responses in Copilot Chat will look (similar formatting, compressed chain of thought), feel (smoother streaming, resume/retry and voice dictation) and behave (deliver clickable citations and tool execution traces) very similarly to Copilot Chat responses themselves.

item.title: RM570444: Microsoft Viva: Viva Glint - New Survey Owner role provides access to survey results
item.description: When a new program is being set up in Glint, there is now an option to designate Survey Owners. Those added as Survey Owners will be able to view and manage certain aspects of the program, as well as see the results when a survey in the program closes.

item.title: RM569720: SharePoint: PowerShell support for brand fonts deletion
item.description: Microsoft SharePoint is introducing PowerShell support for deleting brand font files from the Brand Fonts library used by the SharePoint Brand Center. With the new Remove-SPOFontFile cmdlet, SharePoint administrators can remove brand font files that are no longer approved, licensed, or needed across their organization in SharePoint.

item.title: MC1465780: Outlook for iOS and Android: Automatically apply email sensitivity labels from labeled attachments
item.description: Outlook for iOS and Android will automatically apply or recommend email sensitivity labels based on attached files with Microsoft Purview labels, enhancing consistent data protection and reducing manual labeling. This feature rolls out globally in late September 2026 with no admin action required.

item.title: MC1465779: Outlook for Mac: Sensitivity label recommendations and auto-labeling from attachments
item.description: Outlook for Mac will auto-apply or recommend Microsoft Purview sensitivity labels on emails based on attached files' labels, enhancing consistent information protection. This feature rolls out worldwide in late September 2026, requires no admin action, and helps reduce manual labeling while supporting compliance.

item.title: MC1465777: Enhanced Slide Navigation with Up and Down Arrow Keys in PPT Live
item.description: PowerPoint Live now allows slide navigation using Up and Down Arrow keys, enhancing presenter control. This update, rolling out globally from mid-August to early September 2026, requires no action but may prompt updates to training materials. Existing navigation methods remain unchanged.

item.title: MC1465773: Microsoft Viva Engage: Microsoft Entra permissions required for community and membership administration
item.description: Starting late September 2026, Microsoft Viva Engage will require Microsoft Entra permissions—Yammer Administrator role or Community Admin assignment—for community and membership management tasks previously allowed to Verified or Network Admins. Administrators should review and update role assignments accordingly.

item.title: MC1465771: Microsoft Defender XDR: DLP alerts will be set as behaviors by default
item.description: Microsoft Defender XDR will set Microsoft Purview DLP alerts as behaviors by default starting October 12, 2026, reducing alert volume while keeping DLP data accessible in Advanced Hunting and Purview. Administrators can disable this rule to retain DLP alerts in the Defender XDR incident queue.

item.title: MC1465770: General Availability of Power BI developer mode
item.description: Power BI developer mode and the PBIP file format are generally available, making PBIR the default report format in Power BI Desktop and service. This enhances source control, CI/CD, and programmatic development. PBIX remains primary, with no impact on report functionality. No user action is required.

item.title: MC1465768: Microsoft Teams: Users can temporarily pause all notifications
item.description: Microsoft Teams will let users temporarily pause notifications for a chosen time to reduce interruptions and improve focus. This feature, available on desktop, web, and mobile, rolls out worldwide from mid-September to late October 2026. No admin action is needed.

item.title: MC1465764: Teams web client users will be redirected to teams.cloud.microsoft
item.description: Teams web users will be redirected from teams.microsoft.com to teams.cloud.microsoft by September 2026. This domain change won't affect features or existing links. Temporary admin control to disable redirect ends December 31, 2026. Organizations should update documentation and ensure network access to *.cloud.microsoft.

item.title: MC1330893: Pay-as-you-go consumption-based meter for your extra SharePoint storage needs
item.description: Microsoft is introducing a pay-as-you-go billing model for SharePoint storage overages, allowing admins to pay only for extra storage used beyond the quota. Available from November 2026, it’s opt-in, excludes education tenants, and requires Azure billing permissions. No user impact; manual storage purchase remains an option.

item.title: MC1311978: Classic Outlook for Windows: User-initiated insights with Copilot
item.description: User-initiated insights with Copilot in classic Outlook for Windows allow users to highlight email text and prompt Copilot for contextual insights. Rolling out worldwide: Public Preview in May 2026, General Availability in October 2026. Feature is on by default for eligible users and integrates seamlessly without add-ins.

item.title: MC1413302: Discussion post previews coming to Viva Engage
item.description: Microsoft Viva Engage will introduce discussion post previews starting early September 2026, allowing users to review post formatting and presentation before publishing. This feature requires no admin setup, affects all Viva Engage users, and aims to improve communication quality. Organizations should inform users and update training accordingly.

item.title: MC1330891: Microsoft Teams: Breakout rooms now supported in meetings with up to 1,000 attendees
item.description: Microsoft Teams now supports breakout rooms in meetings with up to 1,000 attendees, allowing up to 100 breakout rooms per meeting. This feature, enabled by default, removes the previous 300-attendee limit and will roll out from July to September 2026. No action is required.

item.title: MC1443514: Microsoft Planner: Planner Agent chat in basic plans
item.description: Planner Agent chat is coming to Microsoft Planner basic plans starting September 2026, allowing users with Microsoft 365 Copilot licenses to interact with plans via AI-powered chat. It provides insights, task management, and plan creation using natural language and Microsoft 365 data, with admin controls for access.

item.title: MC1245222: Outlook: Share Word, Excel and PowerPoint local files via the new Outlook for Windows
item.description: The new Outlook for Windows will support sending locally stored Word, Excel, and PowerPoint files as email attachments starting early November 2026 (worldwide) and mid-January 2027 (GCC). This feature is on by default, requires no admin action, and aligns with classic Outlook functionality.

item.title: MC1069563: Microsoft 365 admin center: Usage reports to manage metered consumption costs for Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat (preview)
item.description: A new Message consumption usage report for Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat pay-as-you-go billing is now in preview, showing message usage by tenant, user, agent, and billing policy. item.title: MC1423108: Microsoft Entra: Improved restore experience for Authenticator passkeys on iOS
item.description: Microsoft Entra improves the iOS Microsoft Authenticator app's passkey restore experience with a clearer, guided flow for device migration, launching worldwide mid-September 2026. It affects iOS users with iCloud backup, requires no action, and includes updated user guidance without policy changes.

item.title: MC796790: Unified management of app and agent availability and installation in Teams, Outlook, and the Microsoft 365 app
item.description: Microsoft is unifying app and agent availability and installation management across Teams, Outlook, and Microsoft 365 admin centers in three phases from September 2025 to mid-September 2026. This ensures consistent policies, synchronized settings, and streamlined admin experience without immediate action required.

item.title: MC1318124: Microsoft Teams: New search experience for cloud files in the file attach picker
item.description: Microsoft Teams will enable search for cloud files directly in the attach file picker starting June 2026, improving quick sharing by allowing users to find files faster without changing existing permissions. Rollout completes by September 2026, requiring no action but optional user communication and documentation updates.

item.description: Microsoft 365 Copilot Notebooks' multimodal capture—combining audio transcription, image capture, and typed notes—is expanding to OneNote for Android. item.description: Microsoft 365 introduces a third-generation sharing experience with a single "hero link" for files and folders, simplifying access control and updates. item.title: RM569610: Planner: Track task progress with the Completion (%) field
item.description: The new Completion (%) column in Microsoft Planner provides a more precise view of task progress. Users can view and update completion as a percentage, helping teams communicate incremental progress and quickly understand how far work has advanced.

item.title: RM569934: Microsoft Teams: Events in Meet app in Teams in GCC
item.description: Users can now use the Teams Meet app to discover events across their organization, track what important events are upcoming, and plan and organize their own professional events. With this release, Meet app will be renamed to Events app.

item.title: RM492622: Microsoft 365: The Next Generation of File & Folder Sharing

At the heart of this update is the new hero link, a single, powerful link that controls access to your files. Whether you copy a link, share via email, or send the URL from your browser, you now have a seamless and consistent way to share and stay in control of your files.

item.title: RM498923: Viva Glint - Action Taking Report (Public Preview)
item.description: Introduction of a new report that provides transparency into platform activity by dashboard users. Metrics such as report views, Team Conversations completed, and Focus Areas created will be visible and filterable with this report.

item.title: RM523209: Microsoft Purview: Compliance Manager - AI Powered Regulatory Templates
item.description: This feature in Purview Compliance Manager shall enable customers to convert complex regulations from PDF documents to actionable controls and actions in multi cloud environment. Customers can use the converted regulatory templates to create assessments and identify compliance gaps, understand and implement controls to improve their compliance posture.

item.title: RM551199: Outlook: Print calendar events in new Outlook and Teams
item.description: Users will now have basic options for printing calendar events in #newoutlookforwindows and Teams calendar, including choosing whether to show all attendees or display a shortened list of up to 10 attendees via a checkbox.

item.title: RM569930: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Conversational configuration of connectors in Copilot Studio
item.description: Configure the connectors your agent needs, with a simple in-chat sign-in instead of a full settings experience.

item.title: RM557681: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Intelligent Summaries in Copilot Dashboard
item.description: Use intelligent summaries in Copilot Dashboard to quickly surface what’s working and where targeted attention can accelerate Copilot adoption. Intelligent summaries highlight key adoption trends to focus on areas of success. Suggested prompts enable deeper exploration of underlying trends and drivers.

item.title: RM558341: Microsoft Teams: Facilitator detects and answers questions
item.description: Facilitator now automatically detects open questions raised during a Teams meeting and offers to help answer them using web search. When a participant asks a question (e.g., “What is an LLM?”) and no one answers, Facilitator posts a prompt offering to find an answer. Participants can select “Yes” to have the agent retrieve and share the information.

item.title: RM562018: SharePoint: AI overview for SharePoint News posts in the SharePoint app for Teams
item.description: Users will be able access an AI generated audio summary of SharePoint News posts in the SharePoint app for Teams (Viva Connections).

item.title: RM565132: Microsoft Teams: Granular channel notification controls
item.description: Microsoft Teams introduces flexible presets for channel notifications, allowing you to choose between All new messages, @mentions and replies, or Mute. You can further customize alerts for unfollowed threads, tags, and channel or team mentions, as well as control banner notifications for the channel. This added flexibility enables you to set notifications to match to your work style and reduce unnecessary distractions.

item.title: RM565863: OneNote: Copilot Notebook in OneNote on Mac
item.description: Copilot Notebook, an AI-powered workspace for a project or topic built on reference materials, is coming to OneNote on Mac. Bring together your work context behind a project in one place.

item.title: RM569206: Microsoft Teams: Pop out calls into a new browser window
item.description: Microsoft Teams browser app users will be able to pop out calls into a simplified call window that stays available while they navigate away from, hide, or minimize the tab or progressive web app (PWA) hosting the call. This helps users multitask and collaborate more easily during calls.

item.title: RM557970: Microsoft Teams: Centralized notification settings for channels
item.description: Centralized notification settings streamline channel notification setup and management. Available in Teams settings, users have a single place to review and adjust notifications for all visible channels, instead of managing each individually.

item.title: RM568786: Microsoft Edge: Inline Switching for Workspaces
item.description: Workspaces Inline Switching manages multiple Workspaces in a single window. Selecting a Workspace swaps in its tabs, theme, and context, with an easy return to the default space.

item.title: MC1462472: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Draft Outlook emails directly in Copilot Chat on mobile
item.description: Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat on mobile will embed an Outlook email draft experience, allowing users to draft, review, and open emails in Outlook Mobile seamlessly. This feature, enabled by default, rolls out worldwide from mid-August to mid-September 2026 with no admin action required.

item.title: MC1462470: Microsoft Teams: Clearer text highlighting in dark mode and high contrast mode
item.description: Microsoft Teams will improve highlighted text visibility in dark and high contrast modes for a more consistent, accessible editing experience. Rollout starts mid-September 2026, completing by early October 2026. This is a visual enhancement only; no user action is required.

item.title: MC1462469: Microsoft Teams and Google Calendar sync retirement

item.description: Support for the Cloud Application Administrator role in Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps' App Governance will retire on September 26, 2026. item.title: MC1462463: Teams Admin Center - Single pane for monitoring
item.description: Microsoft Teams admin center will launch a single pane for monitoring and troubleshooting meetings and calls organization-wide, available from late September to mid-October 2026. Admins can view in-progress and completed meetings, identify issues, use detailed diagnostics, apply filters, export data, and leverage Microsoft 365 Copilot for analysis.

item.title: MC1462460: Microsoft Entra: Domain update for My Account and identity self-service experiences
item.description: Microsoft Entra is updating its self-service identity management domain from myaccount.microsoft.com to myaccount.cloud.microsoft, consolidating related sites for a unified experience. The change rolls out worldwide in late November 2026. Users need no action; administrators should ensure *.cloud.microsoft domains are allowed in network policies.

item.title: MC1309743: Viva Engage: Email updates for frontline users without an active Exchange mailbox
item.description: Starting mid-September 2026, Viva Engage will stop sending email notifications to users without valid mailboxes, reducing email system load and improving delivery. Users with supported mailboxes will be unaffected. Notifications via Teams remain unchanged. No action is required, but admins should review mailbox configurations and update support documentation.

item.description: You can release your secure print jobs by scanning a QR code at any printer and access your print workflows from a browser on any device, all signed in with your Microsoft 365 account.

item.title: RM503564: Microsoft 365 admin center: Organizational Messages now supports Hybrid-joined Devices
item.description: Organizational Messages now supports Hybrid-joined Devices.

item.title: RM512431: Planner: Custom Templates
item.description: Custom templates let you create reusable, pre-designed layouts tailored to your organization’s needs, ensuring consistency and saving time. They provide flexibility to standardize content while allowing easy customization for specific scenarios.

item.description: Microsoft is introducing a new Native Sync Engine for OneDrive on macOS, improving sync speed, reliability, and resource efficiency. item.title: MC1258000: Microsoft Purview: Data Security Investigations – analyze files tied to endpoint DLP alerts
item.description: Microsoft Purview’s Data Security Investigations will add endpoint Data Loss Prevention (DLP) events as a queryable source, enabling admins to analyze related files automatically. item.description: Microsoft 365 admin center Usage reports domains will change starting mid-August 2026, with current and new domains active in parallel for at least 30 days. item.description: Copilot in OneDrive Web enables users with a Microsoft 365 Copilot license to find, understand, analyze, create, and act on files using natural language without opening each file.
